rites.name: Corilliasor
rites.text: A shadowed ritual practiced by tribal people to call on hidden forces. It belongs to a wider family of mystic observances and first appeared in a collection of forsaken settlements.

rites.name: Valarnia Amauria
rites.text: A set of inherited gifts that a tribal people of hunters carry in their blood. The gifts are listed for that people, and a later rulebook revision of them is noted as well.

rites.name: Nellorum
rites.text: A binding vow that gathers a company of fighters from one clan into a single ring of loyalty. Those who swear it stand together as one unbroken circle.

rites.name: Ceornastia
rites.text: A feinting kick that sweeps past a foe's head before snapping back to strike the skull from behind. It slips past defensive guards, though the striker moves a little slower for it.

rites.name: Caurniases
rites.text: A basic ancestral rite lets a shapeshifting kinfolk sharpen their own human odor until wild beasts grow uneasy while tamed beasts bow to them as lord. A spirit of the forebears passes it on.

rites.name: Noria
rites.text: A set of inherited bindings that strengthen a brute's body and combat prowess when its bearer calls upon them. Its bearers are the heavy-handed kin who wield these bindings in battle.

rites.name: Oriasium
rites.text: A signature rite practiced by a forest-dwelling people who draw on smoke, ash, and hallucinogenic plants. Their spirit-craft also calls on rain, rivers, and clouds.

rites.name: Vollium
rites.text: A set of inherited gifts held by one people, taught by spirits of suffering or by venomous beasts serving a wolf-like patron. The gifts let a bearer endure their own torment and return a portion of it to foes.

rites.name: Lausternor
rites.text: A minor ritual in which a wanderer taps a patterned beat on sticks to honor a guardian spirit. The beat grants one extra die for a single trial in the spirit realm, and must be renewed after three days of rest.

rites.name: Maseontes
rites.text: A dark ritual of blood sorcery placed on a warrior caste at the close of a long war. Its full power stays dormant for centuries before it finally awakens.

rites.name: Valestaunum
rites.text: A discipline of the dead that lets its practitioners command the spirits lingering between life and rest. It was passed down through a line of followers who revered an ancient god of the underworld.

rites.name: Riarnus Sisontanum
rites.text: A learned gift of the hunter-folk that lets a wanderer strike targets others could never reach. It is passed on by a feathered ghost of the crows.

rites.name: Restia Seriastia
rites.text: An ancient art of blood sorcery practiced by night-dwelling sorcerers across distant lands. It draws on many old faiths and predates the later arts that it resembles.

rites.name: Ranor
rites.text: A set of gifts granted to the cursed that strengthens their staying power. The gifts are taught by the spirits of tireless beasts and of ancient woods and peaks.

rites.name: Neonum Sereostor
rites.text: A state of mind in which a shapeshifter loses self-control because of fear. It takes hold when terror overwhelms the will of the one who changes form.

rites.name: Mauntiasium
rites.text: The word for the hidden craft of sorcery, whose meaning is spoken power. Those who once lived under old crowns learned simple protective charms, and cults holding deep secret lore can call the dead back to life.

rites.name: Celes
rites.text: A discipline practiced by reformed transgressors who serve a scaly river god as communal killers. In old days, when river-beasts walked openly among people, they were revered by its followers.

rites.name: Corisornes Sereostium
rites.text: A forgotten craft of binding old ward-oaths to a chosen stretch of earth. Its single surviving rite is said to have come to a seer in a vision, and it demands a costly offering.

rites.name: Vaulanum
rites.text: A deathless sorcerer is born from a forgotten, forbidden ritual of endless life. Practitioners pursue the lost formula at great cost, and some eastern lineages reached a similar undeath before they vanished.

rites.name: Liarnantus
rites.text: A dark craft of hexes that brings ruin and bad luck onto others, taught only to blood-drinkers who bargain with fiends. It is a forbidden art whispered of in old courts, never written into the common rulebooks.

rites.name: Mistontanum
rites.text: Ancient people learned to keep flame at their hearths, bargaining with fire-spirits who agree to hold back their hunger. A chosen one who touches the blaze may shrug off its burns for a time, at the cost of a spent spark of inner power.

rites.name: Niastor Valiastanum
rites.text: Among the people of this realm, a saeld is a sung recitation that carries lineage or the record of past happenings. It is spoken aloud in ordinary speech as a kind of chanted memory.

rites.name: Lilanum Corantium
rites.text: A ritual craft that turns simmering wrath into useful brews and toxins. Only a sealed circle of practitioners may pass it on, and outsiders who learn it are hunted down.

rites.name: Miasanum Mauleosor
rites.text: An ancient discipline that quiets the inner hunger by seeking hidden knowledge and finding joy in both suffering and rapture. Its followers arose from older desert rites and branch into related practices.

rites.name: Valeornium Miaria
rites.text: A discipline of the road-minded that guides its followers along a royal way of rule. Practitioners of this creed are called Ashwen by those who walk beside them.

rites.name: Amerniarum
rites.text: A harvesting practice used by one of the three ways of gathering a precious healing substance. It is one of the methods a people draws upon to collect that substance.

rites.name: Siasteror
rites.text: A set of ancient practices kept by wandering beast-kin who live far from settlements. They are used only as a last resort, when staying alive is the best that can be hoped for.

rites.name: Telaustus Veonirium
rites.text: A dark ritual that grants a chosen few endless life after their remains are preserved and their spirit is sent through a trial in the afterlife. Those who pass return as unending servants of a ruling domain.

rites.name: Vantes Ceror
rites.text: A practitioner pierces one eye with a needle, keeping the other shut, to glimpse the spirit realm beyond the veil. The strain harms the pierced eye, so prompt healing is urged to prevent lasting blindness.

rites.name: Vestia
rites.text: A trickster's skill that lets a wearer cross ice and drifting snow as though it were firm earth, leaving no footprints behind. It is taught by a spirit of frozen water.

rites.name: Nantes
rites.text: Wearers who have learned to slip into another creature's hide and take its shape. They usually become beasts by donning the pelt of their chosen animal.

rites.name: Nillum Raunesum
rites.text: A ritual lets a practitioner pass between the living world and a gloomy realm of spirits by marking crosses over both eyes with a dark powder and stepping into a deep pool of darkness. The passage carries whatever the traveler can hold.

rites.name: Conanum
rites.text: A class of ritual practices that tribal shapers perform in the untamed wilds. They were first recorded in a sacred scroll kept by the wandering clans.

rites.name: Orollum
rites.text: A guardian discipline practiced by certain sworn shapeshifters born at dusk. They stand watch over sacred sites that matter to their kind.

rites.name: Malia
rites.text: A blessing granted to a clan of brutal shapeshifting warriors that gives its bearer enormous, razor-edged jaws. The bite can strike down a foe, but only after the bearer has seized and held them.

rites.name: Orinium
rites.text: A belief that a being can rise into divinity through extraordinary power. Many seekers of this rise aim to dissolve a veil that hides the world from the gods.

rites.name: Contes
rites.text: A totemic power that lets a chosen bearer of divine blood command one animal kind. The bearer picks that creature when first gaining the gift, and it need not match the bloodline's own patron.

rites.name: Seosor
rites.text: A loose, unorganized art of blood-working passed among rebel wandering bands. Its practitioners seek out hidden teachers and dangerous old books, and they fall into four loose ranks.

rites.name: Lontum
rites.text: An ancient sorcery practiced by a secretive brotherhood of blood-drinkers who worship a serpent deity. Outsiders give it a different name, and its rites are passed down through generations of initiates.

rites.name: Seriallanum
rites.text: A high rite of inner sight where a leader drinks charged essence, bathes in slaughtered beast-blood, and meditates to pierce a hidden veil. The seeker must resist haunting memories and temptations before glimpsing what lies beyond.

rites.name: Coristus
rites.text: A mystic bond joins members of a created band. A mark burned into the skin lets each member share small measures of their inner fire with the others, easing shared work but spreading the influence of their blighted homes.

rites.name: Velanor
rites.text: A form of spiritual sorcery that channels the devotion of a fallen being's human worshippers. It is practiced by ancient beings of the old era, while their modern counterparts rely on a different discipline instead.

rites.name: Coristanum
rites.text: A secret rite lets a cult of hunters consume the flesh of slain monstrous beings to take on their immortality and dreadful powers. Only one hunter may claim each power, and the eaters risk harm from the sheer quantity of raw meat.

rites.name: Valaulanum
rites.text: A distant killing craft that works through the power of living essence. Practitioners strike foes from afar by drawing on the vitality that flows through all breathing things.

rites.name: Amestianium
rites.text: A discipline for reshaping matter, from reading the hidden nature of a substance to kneading its form and purpose as if it were soft clay. Practitioners of an old refining school use it.

rites.name: Torenes
rites.text: A grim ritual in which bound-spirit relics are hurled into a hollow void-well to be unmade. Its practitioners believe the offering scatters the essence of the relics into nothingness.

rites.name: Rillium Corianelia
rites.text: A set of inherited blessings shared among a sworn brotherhood of wandering shapers. Those lacking the usual spark pay a different toll to call upon them, and kin outside the inner circle may share their benefits.

rites.name: Sollor
rites.text: A set of combined mystic arts known only to certain guardians of the dead. Those who have passed a sacred sundering ritual are the only ones taught them.

rites.name: Mausia
rites.text: A flash of sudden insight that lets a rat-folk kindred recall distant ancestral memories. It is a faint echo of a greater recollection gift held by lizard-folk.

rites.name: Telernanum Valeornor
rites.text: A set of sacred practices reserved for one closed clan, passed down in secret. Outsiders who attempt them find the workings much harder to achieve.

rites.name: Tontor
rites.text: A practitioner draws on their inner spirit to quicken their movements. The state resembles a sustained, savage fury that refills its own strength as it is spent, much like a rival swiftness art.

rites.name: Amaustium
rites.text: A ritual where a bearer pours a jet-dark oil onto still water, turning the surface wholly opaque for a week. It changes nothing else and fades once dispersed or diluted.

rites.name: Reollum
rites.text: A bestowed favor lets a wanderer spend inner radiance to gain a boon tied to the form she wears and the lineage she carries. It rewards those who draw on their natural gifts.

rites.name: Corosistium
rites.text: A chosen champion receives a sacred gift from a deity, often their own maker or a new patron. It lets them rise to fame through bold deeds beyond ordinary people, and in time they draw on its power directly.

rites.name: Lisaunor
rites.text: A quiet ritual in which a shapeshifter draws in clean air thirteen times while emptying her thoughts of everything except devotion to the living earth.

rites.name: Mintanum
rites.text: A wild state of frenzy that spreads through a crowd when otherworldly beings stir it up. Those caught in it lose all restraint and act with unchecked fervor.

rites.name: Veollus Vontes
rites.text: A shapeshifting warrior projects an unshakable air of command that hides any hint of weakness. It shields against those who probe for flaws or read inner auras, though minds may still be reached with effort.

rites.name: Cales
rites.text: A tithe or deliberate act that must be given to make a hidden enchantment take hold among the otherworldly folk. It is the cost woven into any minor charm.

rites.name: Sernistia
rites.text: A sacred invocation in which a hunter calls on protective holy patrons for aid. Its strength rises with the devotion of the caller, the sanctity of the site or object involved, and the appointed day of the patron.

rites.name: Vistanum
rites.text: A dark blessing that lets a seer spend inner dread to sharpen hidden-lore workings. It also grants extra strength to rites that bring misfortune down upon a rival.

rites.name: Sirnia Valiarinium
rites.text: A practitioner stands in one spot and hears the unseen spirits of that ground, learning what lies there and what has passed. In a fight, it reveals the terrain, the likely hiding places of enemies, and the layout of the field.

rites.name: Tialanum Liarus
rites.text: A discipline of marrow-craft that draws on skeletal remains to channel dread and mortality. Spirits of night birds and carrion watchers pass its methods to those who have died once already.

rites.name: Riarnus Lesontum
rites.text: A set of inherent gifts that bind every shaped-metal edge to the wandering shapeshifters of the land. Each cutting tool carries a share of these bonds, whether it is a long sword, a surgeon's knife, or a pair of garden shears.

rites.name: Miania Caunirium
rites.text: A warrior's inherited discipline lets trained fighters grasp any sharpened implement with ease. Such mastery applies to every bladed tool, and it cannot be combined with other learned skill tiers.

rites.name: Saulirnor
rites.text: A hidden craft of serpent-blooded adepts who draw strength from a sealed ancestral teaching. It hardens the body against harm, working as a supernatural shield much like endurance toughens the flesh.

rites.name: Sesium Marum
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a chosen warrior spend a spark of inner radiance to bypass an object's toughness for one strike, striking directly at its core. The bearer also begins with a natural skill at wielding weapons.

rites.name: Coreosium
rites.text: A set of marks that rise on those who wander deep into a dream-realm, revealing their hidden otherworldly nature more fully the farther they travel.

rites.name: Vilus
rites.text: A sacred term used by a secretive clan of night-keepers to describe a rite of joining into a single unified self. It names the state reached when a member fully merges with the collective.

rites.name: Teostes
rites.text: A binding agreement struck between a living mortal and a spirit at the instant a bound one dies. The deal ties the two together into a single joined pair.

rites.name: Teloranum Maurnises
rites.text: A craft of cursed inheritance binding a fighter's life-fluid to fury and raw aggression. Hunter-spirits of brutal beasts teach its techniques to those who have been cast out.

rites.name: Tintolia
rites.text: A set of sacred gifts that sharpen a hunter's lethal strength in open conflict. A warrior sect treasures these powers as a favor bestowed by a fierce spirit of ruin.

rites.name: Veolanum
rites.text: A mystical craft in which practitioners work with the element of stone and soil and the things that correspond to it. It is one branch of a wider discipline of arcane art.

rites.name: Volines
rites.text: A set of sacred gifts granted to devout followers, drawing power from a nocturnal spirit of sleep. Some gifts mend the sleeper's wounds while others inflict harm, but all reach into the force of the dreaming mind.

rites.name: Telanum Nollantus
rites.text: A ritual that wipes recollections from a mortal's thoughts, often used by hidden feeders to conceal the traces of their hunger.

rites.name: Coreornum
rites.text: A fury that seizes a hunter when control slips, turning the wielder into a mindless beast that strikes at anything moving. Spirits flee from such a being, and no one can reason with it.

rites.name: Mintes
rites.text: A craft of linking small carved figures to distant forces through sympathy, so they work for both living and dead. Each use draws a steady draw of vital essence, and the figure goes dormant the moment that essence is withheld.

rites.name: Teornasum
rites.text: A wielder's arcane working that alters the nature of something in the world. It can change an ordinary object into another material or lend a common creature a dangerous quality.

rites.name: Rallia
rites.text: A set of hidden powers that bend shadows and nightfall, and the dread and sorrow that gather in the dark. Those who wander in the night draw on them most often.

rites.name: Reraules
rites.text: A sorcerous path followed by the fox-spirit folk of the land. Practitioners of this craft channel their inner magic through disciplined study of the old ways.

rites.name: Telostor
rites.text: A discipline of the ancient order that channels a hidden inner current into the body, letting a practitioner draw on the currents of decay. Its clean counterpart is a sister form that works through strength.

rites.name: Teosia
rites.text: Four spheres of enchantment let a practitioner command a particular set of linked forces. Each sphere gathers its own bundle of associations under one hand.

rites.name: Moniasanum
rites.text: A set of guarded magical paths followed by outsiders who joined a dominant seafaring realm's orders. Each path draws on one primal force, treating its physical forms and its symbolic meanings as a single thing.

rites.name: Coralloria
rites.text: A fighter uses extreme bodily flexibility and a coiled spring-like leap to deliver a blow from an unexpected angle. The strike is often combined with punches and kicks, and it cannot be blocked, only dodged.

rites.name: Corerus
rites.text: A disciplined inner practice that channels the rising, bright force of the world into motion. It is followed as a sacred path by those who seek balance through vigorous, controlled movement.

rites.name: Serisium
rites.text: A disciplined, contemplative fighting art practiced by a secretive monastic order. Those who master its stillness are said to reach inner awakening and a higher state of being.

rites.name: Sillentia
rites.text: A guardian discipline taught to those who shield others from harm. Its practitioners read the moment to advance and the moment to withdraw, favoring cunning over reckless valor.

rites.name: Leosia Tiantaurus
rites.text: A discipline of altering one's own unsettling presence, able to drive beasts into frenzy or briefly calm the restless dread around the practitioner. It is favored by former adherents of two metal-based refining schools.

rites.name: Nasor Tialia
rites.text: A set of inherited powers taught by sickness-spirits to a select lineage of shapeshifters. Outsiders who try to receive these powers fall ill and perish.

rites.name: Telesium Canintus
rites.text: A dark power granted by a fiend to those who swear service or bind themselves in a covenant with it. The gift lets the bound mortal do things beyond ordinary reach.

rites.name: Telonium
rites.text: A forbidden art in which only the most ancient beings of the wild can bend the sleeping minds of mortals. Those ensnared wander as obedient servants, and their dreamed strength is drawn away to feed the caster's power.

rites.name: Caustolia
rites.text: A sorcerous art taught by infernal beings, letting a practitioner work strange powers drawn from the dark. It is known as a forbidden branch of the older ritual craft.

rites.name: Tillia Serares
rites.text: A ritual art that pours hidden wonder into a human being so they can step across into the realm of dreams. The recipient gains a passage they could never walk alone.

rites.name: Coraulonus
rites.text: A collective term for the varied ways that fae-like beings draw wonder out of ordinary people or kindle it within themselves. It describes the many techniques used to gather this enchanted essence.

rites.name: Rallanum
rites.text: A blessing granted by a desert order to chosen shapeshifters. Those who carry it gain a bonus when seizing an opponent or breaking free from a hold.

rites.name: Cianaullum
rites.text: A deep dreamlike trance that the seers of a night-walking brotherhood must enter in order to pass into the realm beneath the world.

rites.name: Coralintum
rites.text: A hidden inner spirit lives within a caster and grants magic power, its voice dimmed by the bond. When the spirit is loosely matched, it nags the caster like a conscience.

rites.name: Valontum Mauntium
rites.text: A grace bestowed on a nimble performer that lets her retry her agile displays and adds a little extra to her evasions in combat.

rites.name: Villauranum
rites.text: A bestowed blessing that a shapeshifter spends a stored essence to gain swiftness and quickness of reaction. It lasts a number of turns equal to the bearer's inner strength.

rites.name: Vontenia
rites.text: A discipline of sacred fire-craft that lets devoted practitioners command warm, radiant life-force. Their inner flame restores the wounded and empowers their fists, and it spreads vitality into anyone they touch.

rites.name: Orintes
rites.text: Spirit-granted powers given to living creatures who are taught how to wield them. Those who can channel them must have the proper means to use them.

rites.name: Sereolor
rites.text: A set of uncanny workings used by members of a fading courtly circle to stir fear and dread. Their power follows the emotions tied to the circle that holds them.

rites.name: Tirnolles
rites.text: A gift bestowed upon a select circle of wanderers, whose minds burn like restless embers. Those touched by it may draw on their inner shimmer to sharpen their quick thinking, trading spent reserves for extra mental focus.

rites.name: Veosor
rites.text: A whispered path of gilded passage that a practitioner may walk to rise into the highest rank of wizardry. Its existence is more talked about than proven.

rites.name: Serirum
rites.text: A sacred oath-curse that compels a bearer to perform or refrain from a particular deed. Those bound by it cannot escape its command.

rites.name: Ciastasanum
rites.text: A fighter grabs a rival and transforms into a stronger shape while squeezing, so the grip grows tighter as the change takes hold. Breaking free requires winning a contest of raw strength, and the cost is a point of fury.

rites.name: Amarnorus
rites.text: A learned sight-craft that lets its user perceive clearly in total darkness. The eyes glow with a green light while the craft is active, and a feline spirit teaches it.

rites.name: Amarnium Orontes
rites.text: A spent reserve of inner charm lets a wandering shapeling plunge a long distance without harm. The same gift steadies its feet on narrow perches.

rites.name: Liareolum
rites.text: A nine-step path of inner unshackling that strips away false self-images and social conditioning. Its practitioners endure harsh trials to reach a hidden truth already dwelling within every soul.

rites.name: Teostasia
rites.text: A grace that lets its bearer ascend nearly any surface with ease. It grants a notable bonus to climbing, even on slick faces that seem impossible to scale.

rites.name: Corauneria
rites.text: A second-tier sorcerous rite by which warriors pay their life-essence to their order. A guide binds with the giver through a token, a small blade passes between hands, and the donated fluid travels unseen into the guide's waiting vessel, one slow stage per portion given.

rites.name: Miantes Salus
rites.text: A minor ritual practiced by a few shapeshifting kin at sunrise. It closely resembles a nightly counterpart that honors the lunar sphere instead.

rites.name: Volium Miania
rites.text: A zealous current of conviction that flows through a faithful practice, guarding against decay. It carries a stern lament that calls believers back to upright conduct.

rites.name: Telinorium
rites.text: A fighter leaps straight at a foe, wrapping limbs around the neck to drag them down and squeeze. The victim loses a bit of stamina each turn until they break free through a contest of brute strength.

rites.name: Misarnia
rites.text: A minor ritual in which a wolf-kin sings a joyful hail to the night's silver lady at moonrise. The chant's shape shifts with each waxing and waning of her face.

rites.name: Marollum
rites.text: A set of fleeting enchantments used by a court of passionate beings. They stir and reshape desire, following the emotion that drives their court.

rites.name: Orentes Amoria
rites.text: A set of minor workings that a wandering folk of tricksters draw upon to bend small corners of the world. Their reach is faint compared to the great powers of their ancient kin, yet it still stirs faint ripples in what is real.

rites.name: Coreoliases
rites.text: A blessing that a shapechanger can call upon once each day by spending a spark of inner power. It grants extra strength to the body and the will for the rest of a single encounter.

rites.name: Amostia
rites.text: A gift granted to a certain kin of woodland folk, letting them slip unseen among growing greenery. Enough living leaves and sprouts must surround them before the cloak of concealment takes hold.

rites.name: Amostirnium
rites.text: A sacred rite performed by a sworn order of holy warriors that grants its practitioner unusual strengths. It affects only the undead, while living people who drink from the holy vessel are consumed by fire.

rites.name: Ameonus Valaulanes
rites.text: A distinct tradition of combat, bound to a particular land, people or brotherhood. Only those who hold the required gift of training may practice its methods.

rites.name: Testarnum
rites.text: A forbidden discipline that stirs the bright, outward-burning spirit and the restless soul. Its practitioners pursue the virtues of fire and vitality, a path their elders consider dangerous heresy.

rites.name: Vesum
rites.text: A high rite of blood-craft in which a sorcerous order binds the sundered remains of undead kin into a new stone-skinned servant. It is the very method by which that servant lineage first arose.

rites.name: Oronanum
rites.text: A ritual form reserved for one spider-kin lineage, recorded in an early lineage codex. It is performed only by members of that people.

rites.name: Lises Orernia
rites.text: A minor shadow-given gift that marks a single weakness in a foe. Different peoples name it differently, and its workings were once altered before being unified.

rites.name: Lianor Ciaria
rites.text: A heretical discipline practiced by a hidden people that focuses on the inner spirits known as the ethereal and corporeal souls. It shapes how practitioners guide and balance these two aspects of the self.

rites.name: Seriastia
rites.text: A bodily craft drawn from deep forest roots that lets a practitioner pour vital force into their own dead flesh to reshape and strengthen it. Its corrupted twin draws on rot instead, and a select circle of adepts masters it as a requirement for membership.

rites.name: Serauleonum
rites.text: A discipline once practiced by a people who drew on inner vigor to strengthen the body. Over time it degraded into a cruder practice that followed its original form.

rites.name: Cornantia
rites.text: A silent craft that lets its wielder plant false thoughts in sleepers and draw secrets from their dreams. Those who master it can never rest peacefully themselves.

rites.name: Seornus
rites.text: A blood-based craft of hidden power that sharpens the practitioner's own abilities and lets them study or reshape the abilities of others.

rites.name: Telolus
rites.text: A dream-weaving craft practiced by the fox-spirit folk, shaping the sleeping minds of others through woven visions and quiet threads of imagination.

rites.name: Leornialum
rites.text: A set of bargains struck with the passing of days, open to any who wish to bind themselves to them. They bend the flow of moments, though they cannot undo what has already come to pass.

rites.name: Sialarus Milanum
rites.text: A set of restricted ceremonies reserved for a single closed circle of smiths. Their practitioners swear to guard the rituals as secrets, and the spirits that grant the power behind them forbid teaching them to outsiders.

rites.name: Nianterus
rites.text: A sacred grace granted to a swift creature of the hollow wilds, sharpening its timing and reflexes beyond all others. When it evades a strike, its guarding strength is multiplied far beyond the usual measure.

rites.name: Amostaullus
rites.text: A practice of drawing on life-force to bring illness upon another. It is spoken of plainly among the common folk as a kind of sorcery that sickens its target.

rites.name: Lerilor
rites.text: A set of secret ceremonies kept exclusively by one hidden clan of pursuers. Outsiders who attempt them suffer a penalty matching the ceremony's strength.

rites.name: Telanolia
rites.text: A set of wolf-given talents that sharpen the art of stalking and pursuing prey. Those who bear them grow adept at tracking quarry across the wild.

rites.name: Saunus
rites.text: A sacred discipline that channels a spirit into a carved green stone held by its practitioner. A corrupted variant of the art exists and carries its own strange form.

rites.name: Nantellia
rites.text: A hidden long-distance signaling method used by a warrior people in beast form. It lets them carry meaning across great distances without being overheard.

rites.name: Sausiantia
rites.text: A devotional path of blood-working that aids travelers on sacred journeys to holy shrines. It is the chief discipline among the practitioners of blood magic who serve the faithful.

rites.name: Sosiarum
rites.text: A chilling ritual that calls forth a faint, spectral wind carrying murmured warnings and phantom shapes. It scares those caught in it more than it wounds them, sending weaker minds fleeing.

rites.name: Siales Corellantor
rites.text: A reader studies the sky at a being's first breath or change to glean a few hidden truths about them. It offers no detailed history, only hints that point toward where further searching might lead.

rites.name: Listus Mianosia
rites.text: A sacred gift of spirit that stirs a dormant soul into bloom. Its name also carries the meaning of sprouting and growing, as though awakening were a seed breaking open.

rites.name: Ralinium
rites.text: A disciplined fighting practice that uses a long wooden pole as its main weapon. It is taught and carried on by a devoted circle of followers who revere the living earth.

rites.name: Nanes Coraulia
rites.text: A discipline of mending and sickness that lets its practitioners restore the ailing or wither the afflicted. Its blessings may reach beings beyond mortal kind, yet its wielders may never turn it upon their own bodies.

rites.name: Telorium
rites.text: A spirit-bound roar that a practitioner of the sealed-spirit path can sound to unsettle foes. It is recognized as one of the accepted disciplines taught among the shadowed lineage of the soul-eaters.

rites.name: Rantellanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that draws power from the bloodline to shape the winds and the weather. Its practitioners call the skill a gift carried through the veins.

rites.name: Vollantus
rites.text: A disciple learns to govern four restless inner forces that churn like a storm within the body. Mastery means keeping every opposing current in exact balance, so the self stays calm and aligned with the wider order.

rites.name: Tiallor
rites.text: A blood-based discipline of sorcery that draws on the power of fire through gifts passed in the body. Practitioners shape flame by working their own vital essence into the craft.

rites.name: Molum Lontia
rites.text: A sacred power drawn from a people's understanding of the inner spirit, wielded by one particular order of devoted practitioners. It flows through the soul and gives its users command over spiritual forces.

rites.name: Tialornum
rites.text: A ritual art of blood-working practiced by a secretive circle of initiates. It is the particular manner in which that circle channels its craft.

rites.name: Corontus
rites.text: A practice by which a people collects restorative essences from the land. It is one of three methods used to draw healing from the world.

rites.name: Reollantus
rites.text: A discipline of inner balance that lets its practitioners govern the two halves of their spirit. Its adherents are disciplined and steeped in the ceremonies of their people.

rites.name: Valialantia
rites.text: A discipline of flame-working taught in temple halls, where practitioners shape the heat and light of blazing things. It grows out of a wider sacred craft and governs everything that burns.

rites.name: Neorum Amialorium
rites.text: A set of gifts that lets its wielders command the weather, taught by sky spirits and the spirits of small birds. Those who hold storm-kin leanings tend to scorn anyone who seeks to calm the winds.

rites.name: Losium Menes
rites.text: A forbidden craft of dark gifts, granted by infernal lords to chosen outcasts. Its powers spread through hidden whispers and bring terror, corruption, and infernal alteration to those who wield them.

rites.name: Amarnanum
rites.text: A dark rite in which the practitioner calls forth malicious spirits to bring about death and ruin upon others. Those who speak of it treat it as an act of deliberate cursing.

rites.name: Coreostes
rites.text: A set of hidden, guarding abilities given to chosen wielders of a sacred gift. Those who follow a particular pious path usually carry them, though wanderers of other paths sometimes learn them too.

rites.name: Seraulirnum
rites.text: A set of ritual observances performed before a chase to ease the hunters' path or hinder the hunted. They also sow dread in the quarry, who feels the world turns against them.

rites.name: Ceonistum
rites.text: A set of sacred observances reserved for one lineage of shapeshifting hunters, who perform them to honor their duties and the moon's hunting aspect. Each rite plays to the strengths of its practitioners and is handed down only at the dark of the moon.

rites.name: Orentanum
rites.text: A craft of shaping the raw energies of the world through disciplined will. Practitioners of the old orders use it in everyday speech to name their workings with those forces.

rites.name: Tornus
rites.text: A sacred gift of the choirs that lets a favored speaker sway hearts with ease. Spending a spark of inner radiance grants an exceptional triumph in speech after only a few successes, and the effect lasts until the current gathering ends.

rites.name: Amiaresum
rites.text: A discipline of channeling inner vital force into deliberate workings, practiced by adherents who shape that force through ritual and intention. Its name describes the act of generating this force.

rites.name: Ralum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by warrior-bound night-beings to sharpen their inner strength. It grants a range of abilities drawn from skill in combat and a code of honorable conduct.

rites.name: Rileorus
rites.text: A fighter seizes a foe from above or behind with powerful jaws to pin them down without harm. The hold grows harder to break the longer it lasts.

rites.name: Seraustanum
rites.text: A keeper may press a lip-touch once each cycle, spending a spark of inner glow, to lay an unseen shield upon another. The shield does not combine with other protections, and it grows stronger when the one kissed is a young child.

rites.name: Tontus Ciastus
rites.text: A sworn bond of craft that lets its bearers reshape the nature of objects and the threads of destiny. Elder practitioners of arcane tinkering prefer this binding for its skill with both the material and the unseen.

rites.name: Casus Sereonelia
rites.text: A widely followed mystic discipline practiced across several distant lands under a different name in each. It is a teaching concerned with inner knowing and understanding.

rites.name: Rillauntium
rites.text: A discipline that lets a practitioner pour a demonic fury through the voice. The sound it produces carries that wrath outward.

rites.name: Tontus Telosaures
rites.text: A grappling technique where a fighter seizes a foe's limb and bends it beyond its natural range, forcing the foe down in agony. The hold keeps wearing the victim down each round, though it cannot end their life.

rites.name: Vores Coralor
rites.text: A high-ranked warrior's blessing that lets the bearer draw strength from the sun's warmth. It is known under several other names across different peoples.

rites.name: Coresium Menanum
rites.text: A shared empathic calling that some members of a shapeshifting people sustain while they howl, letting their feelings reach one another across distance.

rites.name: Vintaullium
rites.text: A fierce middle shape that a fox-kin can take on, a battle-ready form resembling a wolf-kin's war shape. Its name is written with a different mark in an old book of sacred sites.

rites.name: Serintus
rites.text: A divining craft in which practitioners read hidden futures through the manipulation of time itself. Its adepts are consulted by communities seeking foresight.

rites.name: Seristum
rites.text: A trained body leaps over flying missiles and low barriers with fluid grace. Practitioners strike from the air or cross a battlefield in a single bound.

rites.name: Valiles
rites.text: A lost enchanted speech that a secret brotherhood uses to talk unseen and to recognize its own members. It leaves no written trace and cannot be broken by ordinary codes, and it is passed on through a rite that presses the tongue into a new initiate's mind.

rites.name: Sallostia
rites.text: A discipline of combat in which practitioners wield a special silver blade, passed down among a fierce people of shapeshifters. It is taught as a sacred craft of the warrior orders.

rites.name: Noniria
rites.text: A hidden affinity that ties a practitioner to one face of the dead's power. It shapes how that practitioner relates to endings and the lingering departed.

rites.name: Valires
rites.text: A reckless form of sorcery that the people of the hill tribes call a crude art. Its practitioners are said to draw a backlash from the fabric of time itself.

rites.name: Orentes Vialenes
rites.text: A old craft of moving things by will, once counted among thirteen core arts. Newer practitioners no longer learn it, though some elder makers still keep its methods.

rites.name: Valentus Tausanum
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught among blood-drinking folk that turns their innate natural weapons into the most effective strikes possible.

rites.name: Costirnes
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced only by the restless dead of a shadowed realm of green stone. It is a secret craft known solely to those spirits who dwell among the cold halls of their hidden court.

rites.name: Siarnauntum
rites.text: A woodland enchanter gazes into one creature's eyes and spends a spark of inner power to bind it as a servant until dawn or dusk. The bound creature obeys any command within its own abilities, even against its own welfare.

rites.name: Cilaunor
rites.text: A spirit-bond is fixed between a lesser spirit and one of the ensnared dead. The bond works in a way that resembles a sacred token used by the chosen.

rites.name: Valarnontus
rites.text: A ritual practiced only by one lineage of cat-kin, passed down through their elders. It is a type of sacred observance used to bind members of that lineage together.

rites.name: Orinium Oristia
rites.text: A gift granted to those of the deep currents, letting its bearers hold their breath for a long stretch of time. Murky, lightless water poses no hindrance to their keen sight.

rites.name: Neosaunia
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced within one lineage of tiger-minded combatants. It shapes how their students move, strike, and hold their ground.

rites.name: Taseorium
rites.text: A ravenous rage that seizes a clan of sea-folk, driving them to attack and devour anything nearby. Those in this state cannot be turned from their hunger.

rites.name: Mintarus
rites.text: A healing art practiced by the people of a hidden valley, drawing on the flow of living energy to mend wounds and sickness. Its practitioners are trained within temple circles.

rites.name: Sereontes
rites.text: A ritual by which a spirit being takes on a mortal form. It lets an otherworldly creature settle into the flesh of a living person.

rites.name: Mernaunus
rites.text: A shadow-born blessing that a changeling may pay a spark of enchanted essence to gain added protection while lurking in darkness. The protection holds against gunfire until the bearer steps into bright light.

rites.name: Calisum
rites.text: A combined art joining death-summoning with serpent-binding, learned in two stages. It draws on the lower rank of each discipline before being practiced together.

rites.name: Oriarnium Serones
rites.text: A set of ritual hand postures that practitioners perform in stillness to channel hidden power. They are passed down among a secretive order of sages who guard the practice.

rites.name: Amisanum Corarelus
rites.text: A set of sacred observances open to every member of a moon-bound holy army. One devoted figure may take a path that grants a road-blessing along with a single additional observance of her own choosing.

rites.name: Meonasor
rites.text: A mystical power that certain serpent-folk inherit from their parents. It flows through bloodlines and marks those who carry it as born to the craft.

rites.name: Meorallor
rites.text: A mystical bond ties a being to the elements and feelings of its chosen court. The stronger the bond grows, the more fully that being takes on the court's ideals.

rites.name: Tiarum Mases
rites.text: A discipline that lets its practitioners draw upon the currents of air and sky. They shift the pressure of the surrounding atmosphere or conjure whirling storms.

rites.name: Corerianum
rites.text: A rare discipline practiced by a small hidden lineage of pale ascetics who seek wisdom through the study of mortality. It lets them read the lingering vitality clinging to the remains of the dead, revealing knowledge held within it.

rites.name: Telosantus
rites.text: A discipline of sky-mastery that lets a winged guardian command the weather and bend the power of water to its will.

rites.name: Oriasium Milia
rites.text: A learned art of uncanny allure that lets its wielder draw willing obedience from others and coax hidden confessions from their lips. Certain bloodlines are known to be its chief practitioners.

rites.name: Vasia Amillium
rites.text: A communal burial rite that carries a whole company through the veil to a distant hidden city. Earth mixed with the remains of a recently slain thinking being sends them all together.

rites.name: Sarneollum
rites.text: A discipline that lets its practitioners kindle and command fire, both ordinary burning and a mystical kind of flame. It is used by a certain order of beings to shape heat and blaze.

rites.name: Liasentanum
rites.text: A formal ritual order practiced by the undead kin of a secret blood-cult across the western lands. It shapes how their dark rites are performed and recited.

rites.name: Corentus Mialor
rites.text: A set of blended strike and aid gifts bestowed upon the chosen few who bear the sacred mark. Followers of a particular devout path usually hold these gifts, though wanderers from other faiths sometimes learn them too.

rites.name: Rores
rites.text: A craft practiced by a secretive circle of lore-keepers who shape the living growth of forests. It is a branch of a larger discipline devoted to the green element and everything that rises with it.

rites.name: Siliantium
rites.text: A dreadful visage that a shapeshifter in its monstrous form can wear to strike fear into onlookers. It makes the wearer seem far more fearsome than its true nature.

rites.name: Amantiares
rites.text: A craft by which practitioners wither flesh and spirit alike, perceive the nature of ending, and command the corpses of the fallen. It parallels a rival art of similar purpose.

rites.name: Saurus Valestor
rites.text: A sorcery drawn from quiet inner forces, it invokes many shaded aspects, from grave-working and calm endurance to stillness. Its practitioners turn their hidden reserves outward into visible effects.

rites.name: Liarnausia
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets a rakish spirit-kin seize the minds of beasts, bind them through thought, and reshape their bodies to its will. It resembles the practices of shapeshifting and beast-kinship.

rites.name: Cerniastia
rites.text: A discipline that lets a winged guardian reshape its own body or the body of another being. The art alters the outward form of whoever is touched by its practice.

rites.name: Casteorus
rites.text: A practitioner projects a restless inner glow that can hold other minds in a trance or plant a false self in them. It is practiced by those who once served a brotherhood devoted to refining gold.

rites.name: Siarnium
rites.text: A hidden art by which certain shadowy beings bend growing plants to their will, granting leaves and roots powers they would never naturally possess.

rites.name: Amelistes
rites.text: A class of sacred observances that bind a practitioner to hidden spirits and shape the powers they wield. Several named rituals fall under this heading.

rites.name: Cineostanum
rites.text: A bloodline of hidden shadow-kin draws power from the soil beneath their feet, bending the ground and the growing things within it to their will. This craft works on the land much as beast-speech works on wild creatures.

rites.name: Calles
rites.text: A dark art that a creature of the wild wields to flood a target's mind with terror and dread. Its victims are seized by supernatural fear.

rites.name: Taurnires
rites.text: A rare inherited faculty found only among scale-bearing shapeshifters, letting a bearer draw upon the recollections held by their forebears. It passes the lore of the dead down through the living blood.

rites.name: Valor Valeontes
rites.text: A discipline that lets a bearer of inner spirit command the wills of nearby souls. It cannot sway any being whose inner spirit is stronger than the bearer's own.

rites.name: Meres
rites.text: A ritual craft of ceremonial magic practiced by those born from primordial origins. It is available only to those who share that lineage.

rites.name: Tausor Mianes
rites.text: A shared set of abilities that any shapeshifted wanderer may take up freely. Its workings are open to all who choose to learn them.

rites.name: Telolestia
rites.text: A discipline of working with endings and the stillness that follows them. Its practitioners are guided by the principles of reverent reflection and steady change.

rites.name: Telintanum
rites.text: A fighter leaps onto a foe, clamps her fangs into his throat, and keeps gnawing while she holds on. The bite's harm depends on her teeth rather than her grappling skill.

rites.name: Naullia Laurnastium
rites.text: A ritual that conjures five or more paired dancers from a chosen era, moving to matching music. The figures are illusions without minds, and they fade at dawn or when broken.

rites.name: Meneolum
rites.text: A bearer sheds a little of their own lifeblood to send a brief rush of arcane strength into a nearby being. The rush swells for kin and fades for the already mighty, and it cannot reach the severed.

rites.name: Leostausia
rites.text: A discipline of channeling raw energy and inner radiance toward heavenly realms. Its practitioners find their strength in shaping force and binding will, while turning away from the study of endings.

rites.name: Coraunisor
rites.text: A forbidden practice in which one of the fey folk takes hold of another's dreams against their will. Those who carry it out are outlawed among their own kind.

rites.name: Amaustanum Lianeoranum
rites.text: A practice of wielding the hidden true names of beings and things to shape them with spoken sound. It requires a speaker who is fully embodied and pronounces each name exactly.

rites.name: Valontus
rites.text: A practitioner plants their core low and drives their energy into the ground, becoming far harder to topple. While rooted they cannot move, though a crouched stance eases the strain.

rites.name: Maustes
rites.text: A ceremonial practice that a select circle of shapeshifting feline keepers performs. It is reserved solely for members of their own lineage.

rites.name: Cernia Saustium
rites.text: A narrow craft of carved marks that draws on the lifeblood of a bloodline to grant a small power within a bound territory. Its practitioners are a secretive sect.

rites.name: Larneonum
rites.text: A set of wild gifts that shapes forest creatures and growing green things into aid for the cursed. Those who hunt in shadow favor it most, though any wanderer who lives close to the wilds can draw on its power.

rites.name: Seriaralium
rites.text: A stone-keeping rite lets a wearer harden their flesh into rock once each day, trading nimbleness and some defense for a sturdy shell. The shell does not combine with ordinary armor.

rites.name: Nenaullium Telianelum
rites.text: A set of binding rites used by brutish hunters who track down those who broke their vows. These rites let the hunters follow a marked quarry and deliver the consequences the quarry has earned.

rites.name: Orauntum
rites.text: A ceremonial mask-form that a fallen messenger of one ancient lineage can take on, revealing a savage, wilderness-bound aspect of its nature.

rites.name: Corarnes Coronaria
rites.text: A quiet inner art in which a practitioner refines their own vital essence through meditation, pursuing a hidden path of harmony with the spirit world. It is studied by those who seek transformation from within rather than through outward ritual.

rites.name: Amolus Oraustia
rites.text: A binding vow in which a sworn keeper commits to shielding a chosen person, site, or object from harm. Those who speak it take on the duty of watchful protection.

rites.name: Seroriantia
rites.text: A sequence of nine sacred rites through which a faith's initiates, both living and undead, are bound into its inner practices. Mastering all nine is required before an adept may advance past the first stage of the nightly devotions.

rites.name: Valilentum
rites.text: A reanimated husk is shaped from a dead, unmoving body by a risen sorcerer who speaks a potent incantation drawn from an old, forceful art of inner vital power.

rites.name: Tastor Tollus
rites.text: A sworn pledge kept by one of the Vell houses, binding its members to keep secrets. It exists to guarantee that what is confided stays hidden.

rites.name: Vosium Mostianor
rites.text: Certain shapeshifters can alter only selected parts of their bodies at will. This partial change lets them keep most of their natural form while adopting a single feature.

rites.name: Corianes
rites.text: A wellspring of fierce inner fury granted to a warrior kin by a silver moon-mother. It lets them move swiftly, endure grievous injuries, and shift shape in an instant, and it can also fuel certain special abilities.

rites.name: Corosia
rites.text: A set of martial bargains that fey wanderers of the sun-bright court use to strike first against their foes. The bargains favor aggression and carrying the struggle straight into the enemy's own ground.

rites.name: Vaullantus
rites.text: A discipline that quiets a creature's inner hunger by burning away every feeling within it. Practitioners of this ancient teaching shape their lives around stripping the heart bare.

rites.name: Veontanum Testirus
rites.text: A discipline of crafting that sets its practitioners on a personal path of creation. It is one of the esoteric ways followed by a dark, cursed lineage, as recorded in an old sourcebook.

rites.name: Renorium
rites.text: A closely guarded art by which one lineage of blood-drinkers can sway the vital essence running through other beings. Its practitioners use it to hold sway over the blood of those they target.

rites.name: Naniares
rites.text: A twisted art by which a cult of self-proclaimed gods convinces others that the practitioner is a divine ruler. Its use is joined to a second art of command.

rites.name: Miarum Tentum
rites.text: A borrowed form that the eldest wonder-folk may wear when they take part in a grand tale. It lets them step into a story as a character.

rites.name: Valiania
rites.text: An innate speech shared by the shapeshifting wolf-folk, understood without teaching and used to converse while in full wolf form.

rites.name: Ceostiarnia
rites.text: A devout discipline followed by undead who once professed a monotheistic faith. Its adherents believe their hungers are part of a divine design, and that obedience to that design helps them hold back their monstrous impulses.

rites.name: Rantiastum
rites.text: A ritual craft in which practitioners bind unseen spirits and drive away those that cause harm. It draws on the power of the spirit realm to hold back dangerous presences.

rites.name: Senus Ranolles
rites.text: A sacred rite in which a keeper of the inner counsel performs a magical working using a small stone taken from high ground. The practice belongs to a hooded lineage of advisers who guard secret arts.

rites.name: Coreontum Serilantium
rites.text: A bearer's chosen mastery in one field of a ruling line's sway. It marks a fallen one whose strength reflects that domain of power.

rites.name: Riasaustium
rites.text: A borrowed force that lends its bearer extra strength or gifts. Certain beings of the wild and the unnatural gain an edge through it.

rites.name: Orauntus Senium
rites.text: A minor ritual of gratitude performed by a hunter after slaying a beast. The hunter slips into the spirit realm to thank the creature's essence for giving its life.

rites.name: Mesanum Nasus
rites.text: A binding vow in which a shape-shifting spirit guards a person's sleeping visions and receives an enchanted currency as payment for its watch.

rites.name: Serales Amornialus
rites.text: A discipline of indulgence practiced by the undead, followed by devotees who chase sensation as a sacred craft. Its founder shaped it soon after the older path of sin took its form.

rites.name: Raliastor
rites.text: A sacred discipline followed by ascetic seekers who try to reach the heights of the divine through rigid devotion. Outsiders and rivals name its followers as zealots and dissenters.

rites.name: Amarellanum
rites.text: A discipline of heavy transmutation in which adepts examine their own nature and that of their kin, seeking a path toward ending their undying existence.

rites.name: Cialeoranum
rites.text: A set of sacred ceremonies shared across the wild people, performed in plainer ways that vary from place to place. Each rite calls on unseen spirits and may demand offerings, and the details of its performance are shaped by local custom.

rites.name: Sereornum Resirum
rites.text: A chosen discipline that a hidden folk practices most readily, and from which their wondrous shimmer is drawn. It is the favored art that feeds their enchanted essence.

rites.name: Nontus Valontelor
rites.text: A harvesting practice used by shapeshifting folk to draw out enchanted vitality. It is one of four methods the folk rely on for gathering that vitality.

rites.name: Telauria Ninausium
rites.text: A combined craft joining sense-tracing with bodily force, letting a practitioner feel a living heartbeat and then strike with it. Its use depends on sharpening the senses and strengthening the body together.

rites.name: Corenaullus
rites.text: A forbidden rite in which a being draws spiritual sustenance from those who devoutly honor her. Scholars argue whether its strength comes from a higher source or from the willing bond between giver and receiver.

rites.name: Lostes Caunia
rites.text: A ward-art that lets sorcerers shield themselves from one another without hostile enchantment. Its protection once allowed rival council leaders to gather and bargain in peace, helping found a united guild of wizards.

rites.name: Tiasalor
rites.text: Each guardian realm holds a set of sacred observances its keepers may perform. Skilled ritual masters preserve these practices and share them to strengthen the spiritual bond among allied peoples.

rites.name: Ranilia
rites.text: A discipline of living through many separate existences so that a seeker gathers understanding from each one. It is devoted to keeping all things in equilibrium.

rites.name: Riasoles
rites.text: A discipline of hunting that walks the wild road of beasts, taught to those who stalk prey through shadow. Its adherents are said to trace their lineage to an old imperial founder.

rites.name: Listornum
rites.text: A discipline of inner ascent in which followers copy the ways of a primordial sire to hold back their hunger. It is practiced almost only by a militant order, and its devotees are called Velnari.

rites.name: Riallestium
rites.text: A discipline of spiraling self-mastery followed by those who seek balance through eight turning stages. It is practiced as one of the recognized paths within a larger tradition of inner craft.

rites.name: Caustollia
rites.text: A ritual division of the soul that holds one of five hidden aspects of a living being. Each aspect is shaped by, and bound to, the whole of a person's inner self.

rites.name: Tiastanum Cestiarnus
rites.text: Beings of the hidden realm can glimpse the material world through this practice. Spirit-kin often use it as a charm to peer across the boundary.

rites.name: Vellanum
rites.text: A dark discipline of the undead that draws power from the agony of others. Its adepts, known as wailers, pursue sin through cries that echo the suffering they cause.

rites.name: Millastium
rites.text: A discipline that keeps a restless inner hunger in check by accepting the surrounding world without meddling in it, turning the practitioner's attention inward toward their own abilities. Its adherents are known as inward-seekers.

rites.name: Mesium Ciarelium
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner channels the holy force of sleeping visions into lifeless matter. It was refined from an older enlightenment taught by a healer-sage.

rites.name: Siasium Taures
rites.text: A dimming rite that lowers a being's inner heat so it can live on creatures' blood instead of its own kind. The subject must remain still within a circle traced in its own essence, and a willing subject needs no contest.

rites.name: Telastor Nialum
rites.text: A discipline that quiets a hungry inner beast by studying the true nature of death and how it connects to other states of being. Its practitioners are known as tomb-keepers, and it has been passed down since ancient times.

rites.name: Serarnistum
rites.text: A gifted singer may spend a spark of inner glow to retake any faltering performance throws. Crowds' adoration also swells their power, letting them draw more light from listeners' feelings during their own song.

rites.name: Coreorium
rites.text: A binding oath is sworn so that breaking it brings a punishment upon the one who swears. It is used to enforce a vow through the threat of a penalty.

rites.name: Cernum Telaustia
rites.text: A discipline of the mind that allows a practitioner to conceal their true nature behind layers of illusion. It is one of the paths followed by those who walk the Road of the Night-Mother.

rites.name: Laustus
rites.text: A caster breathes upon a strip of hide and holds still while an unseen barrier forms close about their body. Thrown objects glance away from it, yet blades and natural elements pass through.

rites.name: Marnor
rites.text: Chosen servants of a ruling council receive sanctioned powers that bend the world toward their masters' will. Each gift is bestowed by a patron figure and splits into three forms: personal authority, battle sorcery, and rites that affect an area and must be channeled through a sacred stone.

rites.name: Amirnallium
rites.text: A ritemaster calls a flaming bird-spirit to a sacred gathering place when a new chosen band is formed. Those who pass through its cold blue fire are either marked and welcomed or harmed by it.

rites.name: Niarnum Tontanum
rites.text: A ritual is performed by a council of mages seeking everlasting life while keeping their craft. It grants the endless life, but it shatters their inner spirits and leaves them unable to work their arts, so they turn to a new blood-based discipline.

rites.name: Cialia
rites.text: A dark discipline pursued by hollow seekers who study a void that opposes all light and living things. Its scholars compare it to a deep pit of bones, and many now follow a newer lineage of shadow.

rites.name: Veostausum
rites.text: A practiced method by which a made being tempers its inner heat so the heat cannot seize control. Its adherents pursue a completion of the self that is said to bring a true inner spirit.

rites.name: Orisanum Tallistium
rites.text: A discipline of iron resolve and personal courage, taught as a reminder of ancient duties. Its followers are harsh, self-serving, and quick to strike those they hold in low regard.

rites.name: Taunolia
rites.text: A ceremony performed only by one winged people to bring new members of their kind into being. It is reserved for that people alone and shapes how their line continues.

rites.name: Voresor
rites.text: A path of devotion where the faithful measure virtue by bravery and truthfulness rather than meekness. The devout are scholars of ancient carved signs and of tales of old deeds.

rites.name: Amillum Caustiasum
rites.text: A sacred rite that transforms a lesser kin of the wild into a full shapeshifting guardian. Those reborn through it are called Hidedancers.

rites.name: Valastes
rites.text: A mystic vision is sometimes bestowed upon a wanderer by an unseen presence. It reveals a truth the one who receives it could not otherwise grasp.

rites.name: Coraunostor
rites.text: A ritual performed by a single leader, guarded by fighters while a distracting group engages a serpent-spirit. Success seals the creature deep underground, where it stays bound for an extremely long span.

rites.name: Vaulor
rites.text: A sacred ceremony in which a chosen bearer is transformed into a new guardian by an awakened being. The ritual marks the heart so that the new guardian is bound to serve.

rites.name: Ronanum
rites.text: A disciplined art that lets trained adepts endure punishing harm, withstanding volleys of missiles, crushing strikes, and even scorching fire without faltering.

rites.name: Narnum Valelanum
rites.text: A blessing bestowed on a wielder that, for a time, lets the bearer's bare hand cut like a blade, empowering unarmed strikes and sharpening their skill with short edged tools.

rites.name: Callus Maleoranum
rites.text: A ritual or celebration that the shapers of the wild use to strengthen the spiritual and communal bonds linking their people to the spirit-world. Those who share ancestry with them may also gain a stake in such practice.

rites.name: Oriaresanum
rites.text: A sacred ritual of tying bonds, which two ancient guides are also able to perform. It belongs to the mystic practices of the old orders.

rites.name: Villus Orelonanum
rites.text: Sacred marks bestowed through a solemn rite, each reflecting a band's guiding creed. When worn by a member, the bearer takes on a condition that grants powers tied to that creed.

rites.name: Millium
rites.text: A binding oath used by seekers of righteous payback, made of one common vow and one noble vow. Wardens of the Drowned Quarter bind themselves to it when pursuing redress.

rites.name: Coliasum
rites.text: A ritual of sacred frenzy used by a dissenting cult to honor a monstrous deity. Its participants confess their sins through it, and sometimes it serves as a violent rite of passage.

rites.name: Leornum Corirnium
rites.text: A devotional way of life followed by a band of faithful who honor a fierce and shadowy deity. It guides their inner practice and spiritual discipline.

rites.name: Rarnia
rites.text: A innate sorcerous gift that certain shapeshifting beings carry within them. It lets those who possess it draw on a hidden inner power.

rites.name: Oristiasor
rites.text: A masked circle reenacts a sacred myth of a god slain and reborn, ending when a ritualist endures blows until tears of blood appear. Success lets a chosen killer drain a rival, and the rival's kin share the victim's dying moments.

rites.name: Sianentes
rites.text: A sacred gathering-rite practiced by certain folk and a monstrous clan, through which they receive visions. It is a form of revelation shared among those who perform it.

rites.name: Vausalia
rites.text: A sacred ceremony used by shapeshifting kin that works upon a bound spirit-beast. The rite lets practitioners shape and command such a creature through ritual.

rites.name: Virus Oreollium
rites.text: A sacred ceremony in which a participant is ritually renewed beneath a radiant sky-light. It is performed at a middling level of mastery among the temple-keepers.

rites.name: Lostum Tornum
rites.text: A binding vow in which a bearer promises service to a mortal and receives a store of enchanting allure in return. The bargain ties the one who swears it to a mortal's will.

rites.name: Valiarnor Talontus
rites.text: A discipline of transformation that works through the element of flowing liquid and its related qualities. It forms one branch of a wider mystic art and is known among the cloistered adepts who practise it.

rites.name: Meolor Seostor
rites.text: A sacred rite of longing that calls on spirit, offering and renewal, drawing power from wind, sky and the true names of things. Its practitioners seek a cycle of regrowth and rebirth.

rites.name: Tinum Amellastum
rites.text: A practice in which a wandering spirit is tied into a mark carved or painted upon the body, so that the mark itself becomes a charm holding that spirit's power.

rites.name: Amiantes Valernes
rites.text: A collection of arcane traditions that gathers several distinct schools of magic under one umbrella. It includes practices of cold-born spellcraft, miracle-working, death-binding, and the mysteries of the deep void.

rites.name: Reosolanum
rites.text: A set of ceremonial observances practiced only by one feline-blooded lineage. Its keepers perform these rites to meet urgent communal wants.

rites.name: Valaunia Tellaunia
rites.text: A set of sacred observances practiced by one seafaring people, closed to outsiders except for a single shared blessing that binds a charm to its bearer. The rites were first recorded in a community chronicle of the coastal tribes.

rites.name: Laures Corauntia
rites.text: A sacred blood-craft tied to an ancient forest spirit, once wielded by a secretive lineage of northern sorcerers. Its rites were nearly erased by zealous hunters, surviving only among hidden practitioners who concealed themselves within a rival order.

rites.name: Seriasilia
rites.text: A ritual form practiced by a devoted sect that binds its initiates together. Some observances are reserved for members of the sect alone.

rites.name: Listia Amonelanum
rites.text: A discipline of blood-working practiced across a broad region of believers. Only those with a strong standing in communal devotion can wield it.

rites.name: Laurnia Leolor
rites.text: A grave-born blessing that sharpens a wounded foe's weakness, granting extra accuracy against enemies already bloodied. It also lends added force against the restless dead.

rites.name: Ameornanum Rosium
rites.text: A long rest that the oldest members of a secret brotherhood fall into when their strength wanes. They sink into a deep stillness until the cycle passes.

rites.name: Roreosia
rites.text: A high-ranked ritual of agreement practiced by a sacred order of bull-keepers, performed to bind the community to the rhythms of the soil.

rites.name: Rauntarus
rites.text: A bonded pact that lets its holder shield and mend others. Hulking brutes tend to favor it, since they grow stronger the heavier the weight they carry.

rites.name: Miles Cirneolanum
rites.text: A newly made undead practitioner who devours an awakened spirit is bound by a solemn vow to their teacher and to that teacher's lineage. The vow is a potent covenant that shapes every later act.

rites.name: Teliantasus
rites.text: A tutored craft lets a practitioner turn inner fury into sharp frozen fragments. These splinters can slice like a blade or be flung at foes, and an elder instructor passes the technique on to students.

rites.name: Teostiranum
rites.text: A tier-three ritual practice used by a secretive order of mystics to bind a restless spirit to their will. It draws on an insatiable inner essence that must be appeased.

rites.name: Teontines
rites.text: A bonded binding of rulership that channels command and sway through a sworn vow. It grants its holder a measure of authority over those who accept it.

rites.name: Nintaustor
rites.text: A discipline of altering matter practiced by former devotees of a lead-based rite. Its adepts study their own state and that of their kin to endure a dark passage and reach a renewed beginning.

rites.name: Varnanum
rites.text: A bearer of the old sacred craft lets go of life by piercing their own chest with a ritual blade and sinking into deep water. They then walk into a dim otherworld they have already known, and return by rising from the same pool.

rites.name: Sanum
rites.text: A set of sacred observances kept only by one lineage of fox-changers. Certain of these rites also count among the mystic practices shared across the wider order.

rites.name: Orenistium
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to a shapeshifting wanderer who feeds on refuse. It steels the body against sickness and tainted food, and sharpens the eye for finding salvageable goods in ruins.

rites.name: Amirum Telernium
rites.text: A swift-footed blessing granted to a shapeshifting folk, adding two points to their quickness. It stacks with a separate gift of nimble feet when the bearer already holds it.

rites.name: Reollus
rites.text: A ceremonial practice belonging to a class of sacred observances. It is performed by wanderers at the edge of settled lands to bind their people to the open country.

rites.name: Taleontum
rites.text: A binding rite lets a dark spirit slip into a willing vessel and fuse with its mind. The practitioner calls the entity forth and guides its entry into the chosen body.

rites.name: Rares Vianentia
rites.text: A seer enters a deep trance while holding a likeness or keepsake of a chosen person. Through the vision the seer discovers that person's exact location, wherever she may be, and is often paid in blood for the service.

rites.name: Maurnisanum
rites.text: A hidden variant of a sinful path, devised in secret by an ancient immortal scholar. It follows the same forbidden way but draws its power from longing.

rites.name: Saurontes
rites.text: A signature ritual craft of an ancient desert order whose members were first shaped from unfired earth. Its workings draw strength from the soil and the sands of their homeland, and are aimed at helping the people around them.

rites.name: Coristarnum
rites.text: A joined craft that blends mind-bending command with the art of vanishing from notice. Practitioners must master both the third rank of control and the third rank of concealment to wield it.

rites.name: Tanus Veornus
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner bathes another being in their own life-blood, granting the recipient blessings from a devoted mother-goddess. It was born from a sacred rite of cleansing and sacrifice performed by vampiric worshippers.

rites.name: Rolia
rites.text: A bearer who receives a wondrous enchantment that brings no injury to them. The enchantment passes into them quietly, leaving them unharmed while its effects settle on their body.

rites.name: Valorninum
rites.text: A practitioner can weave, sever, or invent hidden ties between things that share feeling or contact, letting distant targets be touched through them. The bonds fade or linger depending on how strong the original connection was.

rites.name: Saraurnanum
rites.text: A set of blessings given to cursed wanderers that lend them strength beyond what their beast-shaped form allows. Hunting-spirits, earth-spirits, and war-spirits teach these gifts, and certain sky-raiders take to them naturally.

rites.name: Teloraulium
rites.text: A hypothetical rite that lifts its practitioner beyond the mortal state. It is spoken of more often than it is ever attempted.

rites.name: Telanirnor
rites.text: A quiet blessing bestowed upon a wanderer of the wilds, granting a second chance at rolling to stay hidden or to endure the hardships of the wild. It can be bought back with a spark of inner magic when the first attempt falls short.

rites.name: Vaustum Telaurum
rites.text: A set of potent blessings found only in a wild frontier, taught by two rival spirits who wrestle over a devouring tempest. The powers fade when their era closes, though they may one day return.

rites.name: Corenanum Valiantium
rites.text: A set of rites performed on fixed days by keepers of a hilltop house to renew the protective marks guarding their sanctum against a pursuing wild host.

rites.name: Vianus
rites.text: A guarded art of drawing power from the blood of the living and the undead, practiced in secret by one hidden brotherhood of bloodsworn sorcerers. It is treated as a closely held craft passed only within its own circle.

rites.name: Sellanum
rites.text: A binding pact of aggressive discipline sworn between warriors and their chosen war-spirits. Those attuned to the elements often gravitate toward its keeping.

rites.name: Cirnoranum
rites.text: A binding rite that makes a blood-drinker's essence unable to create new kin of its kind. The caster must drink a sacred tonic rather than merely breathe its vapor.

rites.name: Canes Seralium
rites.text: A quiet endurance gifted to a chosen creature, letting it spend one spark of inner magic to bolster its bodily hardiness for the rest of a encounter.

rites.name: Tiastesium
rites.text: A hidden calling practiced by cunning shamans who are born beneath overcast skies. It belongs to one of the seven sacred callings followed by their kin.

rites.name: Valonanum Ameolia
rites.text: A set of quiet gifts passed to outcasts by the spirits of creatures that roam the night. They let the bearer glide swiftly and without sound, slipping past watchful eyes unseen. This craft belongs to those who hunt in the dark.

rites.name: Tarinum
rites.text: An ancient ritual offering practiced by a long-lived people, made to secure their endless survival. Its participants give up something precious to a dark realm so their kind may never fade.

rites.name: Mintes Tiloses
rites.text: A crossing that carries travelers from one place to another by passing through a blazing star's core. It is called upon through a ritual chant that commands the way to open.

rites.name: Sernus Morantes
rites.text: A grappling art where a fighter seizes a foe and hurls them to the ground, turning the rival's own rush against them. Skilled practitioners can send the target flying across a wide stretch.

rites.name: Serarnaunia
rites.text: A hidden discipline of inner sight used by a secretive brotherhood of wanderers who seek unseen truths within the physical world. They rely on their animal spirits as guides toward a single, all-encompassing oneness beyond the senses.

rites.name: Taullintor
rites.text: A taunting feint that unsettles a foe through flashing movement and menacing stance. Winning the contest lowers the difficulty of later strikes against that same foe, and it can be attempted only once per opponent per fight.

rites.name: Vanum Velastus
rites.text: A sacred working that stands as the counterpart to the central rite of living. It is held to be the ritual form that answers the life-giving working of the other tradition.

rites.name: Lialantor
rites.text: A set of sacred ceremonies reserved exclusively for the masters of the gales. Only those who command the storms may perform these observances.

rites.name: Orisaurium
rites.text: A blessing granted to those who live by stealth and quick hands. It sharpens nimble trickery and lets a bearer slip past blows more easily.

rites.name: Amianillus
rites.text: A ritual practice reserved for one tribe of shapeshifters, first recorded in their clan lore. Its rites bind the performer to a sacred lineage of hunters and guardians.

rites.name: Telasum Narneolles
rites.text: A tribal craft that makes the claws of its wielder shatter into fragments as they pierce a foe. The shards lodge deep in the flesh, and pulling them out before healing is required, which makes every wound agonizing to mend.

rites.name: Serornestum
rites.text: A practice that turns a restless spirit into a bound relic. It serves both as a harsh sentence for offenders and as a method of crafting.

rites.name: Cerniantia
rites.text: A tidewalker's gift lets the bearer spend a spark of inner light to breathe beneath the waves and swim with great speed. Leaving the sea ends the gift in suffocation unless the bearer returns to the water.

rites.name: Sarnum
rites.text: A dark craft of curses practiced in hidden circles of crones and cunning folk, drawing on the wild living world. Only those who have bargained with the underworld may wield it.

rites.name: Sontiasia
rites.text: A high ritual practiced by the tyrant lords who corrupt sacred ground. It ranks at the fifth level of mystic working and binds the power of forgotten wonders.

rites.name: Tiarnia Sialanum
rites.text: A sudden shift to a bulkier form lets a fighter seize a held foe and hurl them across the ground. The distance covered depends on skill and raw power.

rites.name: Tiantorus
rites.text: A fighter spins in place and then drives a kick into the foe, using the spin's momentum to add force. Sometimes the heel lashes out as the leg whips around, striking with greater effect.

rites.name: Mareolium
rites.text: A mystical art taught to a line of healer-warriors who draw on a radiant inner force. It lets its wielder endure agony and fight with uncanny skill, as though borrowing strength from the heavens.

rites.name: Ristanum Orialles
rites.text: A raw current of living power that scholars of an old circle once called by a different name. Its craft overlaps with the arts of shaping force and binding spirit.

rites.name: Solleosia
rites.text: These are the powers that bearers draw from a bond with their inner Sin and the spirit that dwells within them. Each one arises from that linked pairing and shapes what the bearer can do.

rites.name: Raustia Nines
rites.text: A ritual craft practiced by devourers of flesh who bargain with hell-bound powers. Its tangled history is more layered than its grim reputation suggests.

rites.name: Telantium Valiantes
