rites.text: A set of gifts bestowed upon outcasts by spirits of storm and sky, letting them command the weather within a small area. Most of these powers only function when the user stands in the open air.

rites.name: Amiastelles
rites.text: A sacred shared-blood rite used by a fierce brotherhood of night-hunters to sever old loyalties and bind their fellowship tightly together.

rites.name: Tanor
rites.text: A mending craft practiced by a sacred brotherhood of healers, letting its wielder restore wounded flesh and troubled minds. It is taught through three distinct disciplines, each guiding the healer's touch in a different way.

rites.name: Tanor Meornum
rites.text: A blessing granted to one who is attuned to the winds, letting the bearer spend a spark of inner radiance to add their fated essence to their swiftness or initiative for a scene. It may be called upon once per trait during each encounter.

rites.name: Naliantia
rites.text: A risky but potent way of working magic, drawn from a disciplined craft. Practitioners who wield it accept grave danger in exchange for great force.

rites.name: Tiasaustor
rites.text: A sacred discipline followed by the spirit-folk of one particular ancestral line, shaped as a path of devotion and self-mastery. It belongs to the ruling spirits of the high lands and guides their practitioners.

rites.name: Ameraurnum
rites.text: A learned chant that the reborn dead shape into focused, potent effects drawn from the ancient wellsprings that brought them back. Its strength grows through several tiers and rewards those who master many different disciplines.

rites.name: Rontus
rites.text: A sacred blessing granted to a huntress of the wild. Those who carry it can turn their bare hands and claws into weapons that deliver killing blows instead of mere bruising strikes.

rites.name: Nalus Seriarnus
rites.text: A discipline of hidden craft that bends the unseen currents of a place by drawing on old village charms and household omens. It arranges surroundings so that fortune and harmony flow through them.

rites.name: Tonentia
rites.text: A dark art of unmaking drawn from the endless rot of the deepest underworld. It cannot be tied to any single bearing of sorrow, and those who learn it must delve far below, yet the art hungers to consume its own wielder.

rites.name: Cestium Lonum
rites.text: A deep-hollow craft drawn from a sea of drifting shards that lies beneath the lowest realm. It cannot be bound to any oath or curse, and each use slowly erodes the practitioner's sense of self.

rites.name: Rilia Oriarum
rites.text: A mighty bearer may spend a spark of inner glow to lend the power of their brawn to their persuasive speech. Their words then carry the weight of their body.

rites.name: Teliarnelum
rites.text: A collective name that a secret order of scholars uses for the four foundational disciplines of their arcane practice. Each discipline governs one domain: destiny, the mind, distance, or concealment.

rites.name: Sausum
rites.text: A set of sacred blessings bestowed upon a celestial figure, granting favor in combat. They are drawn from the influence of a pale night-light that governs warfare.

rites.name: Serillium
rites.text: A sacred craft in which practitioners reshape flesh and bone by hand. It is the signature art of one hidden brotherhood of ancient night-folk, who are known across the land for it.

rites.name: Saunes Valelantus
rites.text: A fighting discipline devised by a legendary teacher of combat. Through a sworn pact among companions, its techniques can be passed down to ordinary folk who stand beside the warriors.

rites.name: Telintanum Moleosanum
rites.text: A set of sacred observances performed by a particular kin of spider-minded folk. They are reserved solely for members of that kin and are recorded in their older written lore.

rites.name: Telauntiror
rites.text: A discipline of transmutation practiced by a wandering folk, centered on the element of iron and the hidden kinships it holds with other things. It is one branch of a wider art of the elements.

rites.name: Leolia
rites.text: A discipline of directing inner vital fluids and a guiding essence into the body to gain extraordinary power. Its practitioners include those who trained in a former order of refiners.

rites.name: Nesolus
rites.text: A term used by a reptilian kin to describe a corrupting working credited to a devouring force. It names the act without explaining its method.

rites.name: Amentes Corarnum
rites.text: A rare gift that lets its bearer step across the boundaries between realms. One of the wanderer's gifts is also carried by a second kind of people, who can use it in the same way.

rites.name: Orauleonia
rites.text: A rarer form of sending, used mostly in grave-craft and in magic that has no fixed target. Where a sending hurls a spirit at an enemy, this craft calls a spirit to answer questions.

rites.name: Nantelus
rites.text: A set of gifts that let a practitioner lure spirits and then unsettle their affairs, and also curse people with physical harm. Outsiders often see these powers as dangerous and sinister.

rites.name: Sauntes Siantum
rites.text: A set of borrowed powers that lets lost wanderers draw on the untamed living world. Its shadowy spirits grant only faint echoes of true natural mastery, yet the echoes still prove useful.

rites.name: Virnanum
rites.text: A fighter performs dazzling sweeping footwork to unsettle a rival, who grows cautious and hesitates to strike. The trick works only once against each foe in a single clash.

rites.name: Teleostor
rites.text: A fervent inner fire that the chosen champions of a sacred order cultivate as their highest guiding principle. Several militant creeds regard it as the foundation of their oaths.

rites.name: Valirnanum
rites.text: A ritual art by which enchanted effects are called forth so that they can reach into the ordinary, everyday world. Practitioners weave dreamlike magic into material reality.

rites.name: Ranor Valiarnes
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a secretive order of spirit-touched folk, it lets the practitioner shape the bright, warm life-force moving within their own body.

rites.name: Tiallaurus
rites.text: Symbolic foci that a caster uses to ease the shaping of power. They hold no strength of their own, yet they can take the form of an object, a place, a sequence of acts, or a surrounding atmosphere.

rites.name: Seriarnus Coreornia
rites.text: Risen corpses are animated by a dark blood-essence drawn from the undead. A secret ritual craft from one hidden lineage of night-kin binds the dead to move again.

rites.name: Coreornium
rites.text: A quiet inner craft practiced by a cold-blooded people of the night, letting an adept shape the hidden, receptive current that flows within the body.

rites.name: Setheisith
rites.text: Setheisith is the concept of the Weave as it is planted by the makers during the Seeding, a quiet and sleeping power that the orders of the Holy Age learned to kindle in temple flames. It is less a force than a pattern of intent that the faithful pour into sacred fire.

rites.name: Viarnia
rites.text: A bloodline's secret art lets its members command serpents and harden their bodies with scaled strength. It also sharpens certain powers of the lords of the blood-court.

rites.name: Meonaullor
rites.text: A set of enchanted bindings lets a certain fey caste bring everyday objects to a half-living state. Each awakened object keeps its own moods and wishes, and the binding only takes hold through skin-to-surface contact.

rites.name: Valosium
rites.text: A mighty war shape assumed midway between two forms, seen as the true body of each such shifter. It bears great strength for fighting.

rites.name: Tiarnus
rites.text: Common, low-cost gifts that the risen dead carry in their bodies, arising on their own from memory or inner spirit. They seldom demand a spent resolve and sometimes work without any test of chance.

rites.name: Corillum
rites.text: A crimson gift that lets a hungry drinker swallow the lifeblood of a wounded foe to mend their own injuries. It works only once per gathering and only against beings whose spirit has already gone dark.

rites.name: Valonauntia
rites.text: A ward-craft taught only within one secretive lineage, built to show that transformation into a monstrous kind does not doom the soul. It forms a barrier that blunts the sorcery of otherworldly beings, yet fails against ordinary blades and fists.

rites.name: Vintia
rites.text: A rank five gift of the warrior kind that wraps a fighter in a mystic guard. Blows strike the wrong place and missiles go astray, and a wind spirit is the one who teaches it.

rites.name: Seraullarum
rites.text: A sensitivity held by otherworldly fiends that lets them perceive the subtle essence that flows through all things. It is a sense rather than a weapon, guiding them to hidden currents of power.

rites.name: Rases
rites.text: A blood-working craft drawn from the shadow-shaping arts, practiced mostly by one secretive bloodline of night-dwellers. Its practitioners are known as the veiled ones.

rites.name: Amirium Sorialia
rites.text: A craft used by fey shapers to conjure false images. Its complexity grows with the practitioner's training, and it runs cheaper in shadow, favoring those who dwell in dark places.

rites.name: Sesia Oreontum
rites.text: A blood-bound craft lets a vampire stir the wild instincts within himself to speak with beasts, call them near, and quiet the savage urges of other undead. Certain bloodlines descended from two old lineages practice it with particular skill.

rites.name: Salleornus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by those who seek to earn a mortal life by shielding, steering, and aiding the other made beings they dwell, roam, and labor beside.

rites.name: Valasoria
rites.text: A spellcaster whose command over a chosen discipline surpasses that of ordinary masters, reaching a depth of understanding few can claim. Rival orders name their counterparts differently, and one opposing circle seeks total dominion through a darker path.

rites.name: Mesia Vianestium
rites.text: A rare ritual craft passed only to initiated members of a secret covenant. Its practitioners learn many rites at each rank, and whether it exists at all depends on which version of the covenant's history a given world follows.

rites.name: Lirnenus
rites.text: A binding craft used by a band of frost-touched wanderers to cast out unnatural beings and strange workings. The more practiced a user becomes, the wider the range of cursed forces they can drive away, and some kinds of users find the forces obey them more easily while others gain strength from the elements or cause their foes to tremble.

rites.name: Orises
rites.text: Forbidden arts draw power from a hollow void beneath reality. Those who seek strength in the dark are often lured into secret brotherhoods that practice these dangerous techniques.

rites.name: Rinanum
rites.text: A bearer may once per scene spend a spark of inner radiance to wrap a figure in a fiery shimmer. Those who gaze upon it must steady their minds or be dazed, staggering through every task until the glow fades or the scene ends.

rites.name: Vaurnialus
rites.text: A discipline of the undead that lets its practitioner reshape the body's dead matter. A corrupted variant of the same craft is known as a rotting form.

rites.name: Serasorium
rites.text: A blood-bound craft practiced by a shunned lineage of night-kin from the northern cold. It turns the practitioner's own frame into a deadly instrument, but leaves lasting marks and drains heavy reserves of life-essence.

rites.name: Amastaules
rites.text: A forgotten craft once practiced only by a vanished bloodline of night-walkers. Some believe it shares roots with a rarer art that only the restless dead can wield.

rites.name: Valeoles
rites.text: An early practitioner who works through reasoned craft instead of spiritual rites. Their discipline is called Ostrel Veldara, and it grants them wondrous effects.

rites.name: Saulles
rites.text: A manner of devoted longing that belongs to the ages of castles and chivalry, where those who dwell in the fey-touched world live out their hearts' pursuits.

rites.name: Cenus
rites.text: A fluid, dynamic craft of shaping arcane effects, not a fixed list of spells. Practitioners devise their own workings and bring them into being.

rites.name: Amenus
rites.text: A class of sacred observances tied to the movements of the heavens. Practitioners perform them to draw on celestial influence, and they first appear in a sky-focused account.

rites.name: Sereosia Telonum
rites.text: A category of sacred observances that bind the wild spirit-places of a land to those who perform them. Several such rites were first written down in an early founding codex, but only later were they gathered under this shared heading.

rites.name: Nintares
rites.text: Undead drinkers wield a dark craft fueled by their life-essence, drawn from ritual devotion and hidden lore. Its origins are disputed, yet its feared nature is never in doubt.

rites.name: Lonia Telaneostum
rites.text: Marks of an inner creature surface on a wanderer's body when their wild nature overwhelms them. The shape of each mark follows the beast they feel closest to.

rites.name: Coraustor
rites.text: A craft of hand-shaping that lets its practitioners forge, mend, empower, or unmake crafted things. It is wielded chiefly by elder folk and works most willingly when done for someone else rather than for oneself.

rites.name: Seniles
rites.text: A gift of the first tier that belongs to one lineage of strange beings. It is bestowed upon those who carry the blood of that lineage.

rites.name: Vaneostor
rites.text: Practitioners develop spell-like effects as they grow in mastery over their craft. These gifts arise naturally when a caster matures in power.

rites.name: Venia
rites.text: A dark art of the blood-bound drinkers that lets them reshape the vital fluid within a body. Its corrupted variant turns that same fluid into a toxin.

rites.name: Riarus
rites.text: A reflective craft that alters how the undead of the night meet their own images in glass. It belongs to no lineage or pact, and any willing student may learn it if they can win a shadowy instructor's favor.

rites.name: Rarniallium
rites.text: A corrupted discipline available only to a people who consume tainted essence. It takes five forms, each a foul twisted version of a purer counterpart.

rites.name: Sariania
rites.text: A discipline of altered craft that lets a made being grant gifts and aid to its kin. Practitioners are drawn from those who serve or once served a refining tradition.

rites.name: Sillus
rites.text: A joined craft that blends the reading of the dead with the sensing of the living. It draws on two lower arts, one for listening to the departed and one for perceiving the surrounding world.

rites.name: Telauntum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a sorcerer pours their own resolve into another's mind, compelling the target to think or act as the caster commands.

rites.name: Serialor
rites.text: A ritual reserved solely for the chief advisor of a secretive blood-hunter order, used to aim a bound and hungry force at a chosen target. Only one figure among that order is permitted to perform it.

rites.name: Corolia
rites.text: A craft of supernatural trickery that lets a practitioner confuse or slip past foes by reshaping their own skin tone and face. Those who learn it most readily use it to pass unnoticed among ordinary folk.

rites.name: Seonus
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth their hidden inner dark-self, reshaping their own body into the likeness of the lesser servants of the underworld. It is a craft of taking on a monstrous guise from within.

rites.name: Amaustium Nolium
rites.text: A ritual craft unique to one shadowed lineage, letting its practitioners bend old sacred rites into dark, mocking echoes of what their mortal ancestors once performed in holy halls.

rites.name: Viallum Coleornum
rites.text: A ghostly power lets a spirit take on a solid body and walk among the living, though strict rulers guard who may use it. Failing to control it can plunge the user into chaos or swell their inner torment.

rites.name: Seraniarium
rites.text: A set of deep, consuming feelings that power a spectral being's hidden shade. They are the inner fires that shape how such a being moves and acts in the unseen realm.

rites.name: Ristia Teloriantus
rites.text: A set of narrow, hard-won powers that blend several inherited gifts of the undead. Only a master can pass them on, and they are shared quietly among trusted circles.

rites.name: Moles Cilia
rites.text: A dread-born craft wielded by a gloomy line of night-walkers who feed on the hidden fears of others. Its users show their victims a bleak glimpse of anguish, making them a feared and hunted sort.

rites.name: Liasinia
rites.text: A set of shadow-aligned gifts that wake when the moon is swallowed by darkness. Spirits of gloom and a few rare lunar beings teach them to certain wandering shapechangers.

rites.name: Ciasum
rites.text: A set of sheltering crafts that wild-natured wanderers weave to guard their hidden refuges. The same workings can be bent into snares laid against the havens of rivals.

rites.name: Carus
rites.text: Undead blood-gifts grant the cursed uncanny speed, strength, and endurance, a piercing stare, a voice that bends the will, and the power to slip into shadow or take the shape of beasts and vapor.

rites.name: Viarnia Tilor
rites.text: A dark craft fuses shadow-weaving with brute physical strength, letting a practitioner conjure shadowy limbs that are far stronger than ordinary ones. Foes unfamiliar with the art may be caught off guard and badly hurt.

rites.name: Neolum
rites.text: A dark art practiced only by a cult of blood-sorcerers and the most depraved infernal bloodsuckers. Its users draw on a nether realm of tormenting spirits to break and weaken their foes.

rites.name: Niantus
rites.text: A dark inner force drawn from the beastly lower spirit lets a bearer sharpen the body and awaken hidden arts. Its use invites the risk of wild frenzy or total loss of self, yet it also guards the mind against outside control.

rites.name: Niaseostium
rites.text: A bloodline-bound power that lets one lineage tie its user to a dwelling through a ritual of shared blood. The bound keeper then senses and commands the space around them like a weaver at the heart of a web.

rites.name: Telialum
rites.text: A set of battle-readying talents mastered by fierce war leaders. Only the wild and unbound can wield them easily, though others may learn them at a steep cost of growing bloodlust.

rites.name: Sillentia Lontia
rites.text: An inner resolve that keeps a lone wandering hunter pursuing their quarry despite every hardship the trade brings. Most who carry it never give it a name.

rites.name: Ciarellor
rites.text: A discipline devised by a secretive order of serpent-blooded scholars studying the dead and a forbidden mother-spirit. It grants practitioners command over their own undead bodies and over restless shades.

rites.name: Miarnus
rites.text: A set of tricks that only one caste of shapeshifters may carry. Spirits of a certain kind are able to teach these arts to their students.

rites.name: Sirellia
rites.text: A set of cunning gifts given to outcasts by a moon and by clever beasts of the wild. They grant the bearer skill in slipping unseen and in outwitting foes, and they are closely tied to the storm-bound lords and their people.

rites.name: Molinus
rites.text: A bloodline art held by a secretive mystic order, letting its wielder sever another's hold over a mind and ease torment by hearing a troubled soul's confession. Its practitioners draw on the powers long linked to sacred calling.

rites.name: Oriastus
rites.text: A fighter steps quickly aside to avoid an incoming blow, moving up to two spaces in any direction. Only those with enough swift timing can interrupt an attacker this way.

rites.name: Teliastium
rites.text: A performer spends a spark of inner strength and plays a melody to lull one chosen listener into a motionless trance. The trance holds only while the music continues, and it shatters once the listener must face a sudden threat.

rites.name: Sianium
rites.text: A devoted being feels a sudden warmth from a distant maternal power when desperate, restoring inner resolve and often offering a vital revelation. Afterward they withdraw to a hidden den to ponder the encounter.

rites.name: Rallor
rites.text: A set of bound powers that a faction of fey-touched folk draws upon, fueled by seething fury and burning wrath. Those who wield them channel raw, consuming rage.

rites.name: Corilles
rites.text: A rare inherited ritual lets a grievously hurt shapeshifter sink into the soil and mend there. The method is passed down by a spirit that dwells within the ground.

rites.name: Ceonor
rites.text: A shapeshifter's half-beast guise in which the bearer can mostly pass among ordinary folk while still drawing upon some of the savage strength of the wild. It serves as a middle state between full animal and plain humanity.

rites.name: Naustor
rites.text: A set of sacred hymns used by a secret brotherhood to sever magical bonds and stir guilt in the enemies they hunt. Its three branches each reach into the hidden wellspring of enchantment.

rites.name: Telantisus
rites.text: A bargain that lets its holder bend chance in their favor. The price is a lasting drain on resolve, though the bargain never demands more than that single loss.

rites.name: Sarnaustium
rites.text: A set of unique inner abilities belonging to a ghostly being's mind, comparable to barbed growths that a living creature might bear.

rites.name: Amestium Contallanum
rites.text: A fighter bounds across the gap and slams into a rival with the full weight of the leap. A clean hit lets the attacker land beyond reach, while a miscalculated leap leaves them stumbling and dazed.

rites.name: Neoneria
rites.text: A borrowed gift of speech that lets a wanderer sway the dull-witted hob-folk of wild lands. Spending a spark of enchanted will grants a sharper edge in dealings with such creatures for one stretch of time.

rites.name: Riases
rites.text: A winged creature may spend an inner spark to hang upon the wind for a span of time, moving at its ordinary pace but unable to climb without rising air. Its falls are softened, so that only a long plunge can truly harm it.

rites.name: Orosor Oronor
rites.text: A discipline of body-shaping practiced by an ancient people in a sundered era, which later decayed into a bloodier, degraded practice.

rites.name: Manum Valeostor
rites.text: A subtle art of chance that lets a practitioner sense and bend the threads of fortune. Its wielders can bestow luck or misfortune, bind promises with unbreakable seals, and nudge the outcome of random events.

rites.name: Amolium
rites.text: A set of hidden crafts drawn from feeling, used by the frost-bound courtiers of a cold realm. Their power rests on grief and quiet despair, which they weave into lasting enchantments.

rites.name: Vollus
rites.text: A practitioner spends a spark of inner vitality and touches raw flesh, which then feeds a crowd equal to their inner strength. The meal sustains everyone for a full day, leaving no room for other food, and the practitioner's digestion becomes unusually hardy.

rites.name: Sentia
rites.text: A bearer can call up a soft, still pale light that hangs in the air over a small chamber-sized space and stays put after they walk away. Spending a spark of inner power makes it blazing, forcing those who would strike the bearer to strain their aim.

rites.name: Caulanum
rites.text: An older discipline of bodily power in which the link between practitioner and natural forces runs deep. Over time it weakened into lesser arts, and its original techniques are now lost.

rites.name: Reosanum
rites.text: A blood-born art that grants the undying an uncanny endurance, letting them shrug off flame and the burning light of day.

rites.name: Tonus
rites.text: A bodily discipline practiced by a people whose inner life centered on endurance. Over time its teachings splintered into a lesser ritual of spectral flame.

rites.name: Teliriarnia
rites.text: A high-level ritual of hidden craft that its practitioners perform to draw forth a powerful effect. It is considered one of the more demanding rites of its tradition.

rites.name: Maleosor
rites.text: A discipline held by a shunned hereditary line of undead who once tended the dead. It lets them command the decay within mortal corpses, but it fails against the undead, beasts, and other non-human remains.

rites.name: Ameorontus
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a fighter shrinks back while striking, forcing the foe to struggle harder to land an attack. It is open to nearly all fighting forms and costs a single action.

rites.name: Amaustialor
rites.text: An ancient tongue from a drowned civilization in which every incantation can be voiced, though it is too broken for daily talk. Those who speak it cast more easily, while the uninitiated hear only noise, which raises the risk of backlash.

rites.name: Serillestor
rites.text: A caster bathes their face in a drop of untainted blood and tucks dried herbs into a boot. Their allure swells until every onlooker is drawn to them, bending gatherings toward their will.

rites.name: Nosernia
rites.text: Dread-powers are the abilities that a spirit can draw upon once its body has been left behind. They let the disembodied act upon the living world.

rites.name: Serarnes Teleoselum
rites.text: A seeker's inner drive that sharpens the mind when puzzles arise. Spending a spark of vital essence grants a surge of mental skill for the rest of a scene, and it fits those who chase hidden answers.

rites.name: Oreosalus
rites.text: A dark practice in which a practitioner calls upon a bound inner spirit that thrives on suffering. Wounds, flame, and even the light of day lose much of their power to harm the one who draws on it.

rites.name: Ciallaustia
rites.text: Dark powers that a fully progressed member of an undead brotherhood awakens within their soul. Scholars argue whether these gifts come from purest ancient blood or from a malevolent outside force working through a monstrous inner beast.

rites.name: Amaulor
rites.text: A joined art that blends a seer's sight with swift reflexes, letting a practitioner move with the speed of a fleeting current while perceiving the flaws in what they shape.

rites.name: Valastor
rites.text: This trait lets a creature govern its wild inner hunger by embracing it rather than suppressing it. Such a being rides rising fury and passion, though it can be swept fully into a frenzy when the strain grows too great.

rites.name: Ranestanum
rites.text: A set of kin-bound observances that only those tied by blood to a shapeshifting clan may learn. Such practices were once closed to them until a later codification opened them.

rites.name: Viastalanum
rites.text: A dark craft of the dead practiced by a secretive guild of death-workers. Its practitioners are known by several names, and the art covers far more than raising the corpses of the fallen.

rites.name: Sonor Taurnostium
rites.text: Ritual practices reserved for one lunar caste of wolf-folk who serve as masters of ceremony among outcast clans. Many newer ceremonies are devised by these ritualists, though others may learn them if they choose.

rites.name: Corostania
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner govern the motion of force and energy. It is shown as an example of a technique that an unaffiliated, clanless being might develop on their own.

rites.name: Amelum
rites.text: A term used among the undead to describe feeding by biting a living person and drinking their blood. It brings intense pleasure to both the feeder and the one being fed upon.

rites.name: Mauria Maniallum
rites.text: A sixth sense granted to reanimated wanderers that guides them toward wells of life-force in the world. It usually sharpens an earlier instinct and often pulls them toward sources linked to their own old craft. Deliberate effort can reach other sources, and it can also reveal who recently touched one.

rites.name: Nasaullia
rites.text: A forbidden discipline of sorcery practiced by those who turn to banned arts. The text outlines the practitioners who wield these prohibited magics.

rites.name: Santes Sisenum
rites.text: A stealthy wanderer's gift that sharpens quick hands for theft and sharpens silent movement. It lets the bearer spend a spark of inner light to push a thieving attempt further.

rites.name: Amenausia
rites.text: A trained skill of unarmed combat that many traditions teach, often as a companion to rougher brawling. Some practitioners use it as the basis for special, almost supernatural techniques.

rites.name: Caurum
rites.text: A fighter drops into a whirling low crouch and sweeps a foe's feet away. The target may dodge the sweep, and a hit deals harm that grows with the margin of success.

rites.name: Valoranum
rites.text: A night-bound blood-drinker's craft in which the wearer's head separates from the body after dark to unleash a terrifying, inhumanly powerful voice. Only those born to the form can wield it.

rites.name: Serasia Larnanum
rites.text: A deeply hidden discipline practiced by a secretive people of spirit-touched beings. Only a few adepts ever master its obscure arts.

rites.name: Relus
rites.text: A bloodline-born art that lets an undead sovereign read the hidden essence within other night-dwellers. It reveals their bonds, loyalties, and the threads of blood that tie them to others.

rites.name: Calum
rites.text: A small, ancient brotherhood of shadow-dwellers draws and reshapes recollections through a shared mind-web. Practitioners lose fragments of their former selves as the flood of borrowed memories grows.

rites.name: Telistium Viriastes
rites.text: A craft of stirring dormant spirits into living vigor, shaping new growth and guarding what breathes. The same practice can also turn toward sickness and venom, spreading decay through living bodies.

rites.name: Ciallanum Vastium
rites.text: A combined discipline that joins mastery of domination with mastery of endurance. It is practiced at an intermediate tier of both arts at once.

rites.name: Caulor Sillentes
rites.text: A practice that lets its wielders move swiftly between distant places by loosening the boundaries of space. Its adepts can also bend those same passages to slow or block the journeys of others.

rites.name: Tantia
rites.text: A sightless lineage of shadow-dwellers mimics surrounding sounds and voices. They turn this skill against foes who depend on their eyes.

rites.name: Telisium Oraunialus
rites.text: An ancient art of the dead, practiced by a single secretive lineage of night-dwellers, whose burial rites many others could learn. Its teachings are passed on to outsiders only rarely.

rites.name: Ceosintes Raulistium
rites.text: A hidden art taught within one proud lineage of undead hunters, letting its users gather shadows around them and snuff out the light. It was forged long ago to fight a deeper gloom.

rites.name: Mestiles
rites.text: A fighter contorts into a shifting shape to wriggle free of holds and grabs. A failed attempt lets the grasping foe inflict extra harm.

rites.name: Valaurolum
rites.text: A lunar passage links two sacred sites. It comes in three kinds: calm crossings opened with mutual consent, wartime crossings opened to reach endangered sites, and reckless crossings that wander and seldom reach the intended place.

rites.name: Cistium
rites.text: A devoted discipline that seeks visions beyond the ordinary realms through harsh rites. Its adherents chase guidance from a hidden patron, while outsiders regard them as perilous fanatics.

rites.name: Vaustum Sereosia
rites.text: A disciplined way of spirit common among a warrior clan of night-folk, whose followers wrestle their hunger through fierce, unwavering devotion to their lawgiver. Its practitioners are known by hooded titles of wandering zealot and silent blade.

rites.name: Sereolus Milauses
rites.text: A practice of reading shared dreams within a woven web of sleeping minds, where the reader chooses a dreamer and a target dream by chance, then slips through to reach it. Ordinary mortals are the easiest to pass through, and certain courtly circles teach it to their members.

rites.name: Cianium Coranteosus
rites.text: A bearer can shift inner temperament like passing through many shades of light. By spending a small reserve of spirit as a quick reflex, the bearer gains extra steadiness against coercion for a while, and attempts to read this bearer's feelings grow harder.

rites.name: Larnum Telintor
rites.text: A keen inborn perception that lets a seeker sense unseen currents between realms and find hidden wellsprings of power. It grants a bonus whenever the seeker peers across worlds or tracks the sources they hunt.

rites.name: Mirnaullum
rites.text: A fighter crouches low and then launches a fierce leap onto a foe, often surprising them. The move can dodge incoming missiles and knocks the target down when it lands a hit.

rites.name: Oreontisus
rites.text: A dark discipline where practitioners let their inner fury run free, finding a twisted delight in the anguish they inflict on others. They shun mercy and keep to themselves, though some are hired to punish wrongdoers.

rites.name: Niallones Mosteontes
rites.text: A rare craft practiced mostly near a shifting maze and its edges. It shapes temporary objects and matter from ancient remains, and its practitioners can also dissolve into such remains.

rites.name: Valosia
rites.text: A ritual in which a member of a secretive bloodline is initiated into the clan's hidden lore by binding them to a blood-sworn servant. It marks the threshold into the family's deepest mysteries.

rites.name: Ciaror Naules
rites.text: A discipline of atonement practiced by followers who seek to cleanse their sins through self-denial. Its practitioners are known as Quelmads, and the path belongs to a wider heavenly road.

rites.name: Celanum Sereornium
rites.text: A discipline followed by those who rule through dread and command, marking their practitioners as Vellari. It belongs to a sovereign court tradition of blood-bound lords.

rites.name: Viraustium
rites.text: A craft of reshaping one's own flesh and form, practiced by a wandering blood-kin who favor the wild roads. It is the hallmark gift of their lineage.

rites.name: Veornia
rites.text: A discipline that lets a controller slip into a living host's body and steer its actions. Stronger practitioners overwhelm the host entirely, while the forbidden ones are said to be restricted to the highest rulers.

rites.name: Oraullum Amosaullus
rites.text: A lord breeds many young offspring of his blood with no aim beyond displaying how abundant his lifeblood is across his lands. The custom is practiced by the old masters of the eastern highlands.

rites.name: Ameolantus
rites.text: A disciplined way of mastering the inner hunger through strict practice of noble and courteous conduct. Its followers bear several honored titles that mark their vows.

rites.name: Mantus
rites.text: A discipline of kinship that binds the wandering dead to ordinary mortal lives. Adherents share the burdens of common folk, hoping to quiet the hunger that drives their nature.

rites.name: Mantus Valostanum
rites.text: A narrower branch of a corrupting discipline that frees the practitioner from moral limits and worldly ties. Its followers sometimes merge it with the parent path and teach it only after a student is ready for deeper initiation.

rites.name: Coresium Amaurnintia
rites.text: A spectral power lets a restless soul push its inner will outward as a violent force that shatters objects and drives unseen hands. It is scorned as reckless, though it proves useful for clearing havoc-ridden places and as a weapon in the wars of the dead.

rites.name: Vilus Vostaulia
rites.text: A discipline of inner awakening taught by weathered elders who grieve a once-proud lineage that has fallen into decline. Its followers are known as seekers of reason.

rites.name: Oreostanum Taranum
rites.text: A set of sworn workings that a faction of fae courts uses to nurture growth and steady resolve. Those who seek them usually need the goodwill of the faction that keeps them.

rites.name: Serentallia
rites.text: A fighting discipline drawn from a darker serpent-cult tradition, practiced mostly by battle-hardened devotees. Its followers are known by fierce nicknames tied to their rage and their horned serpent emblems.

rites.name: Serirneolia
rites.text: A learned working that a sorcerer has come to understand through hard-won insight. It is a spell-form that a caster has mastered in its inner logic.

rites.name: Ameosor
rites.text: A method of ecstatic awakening that the shapeshifting folk use to gather a shimmering enchanted essence. It is one of four such paths of revelation.

rites.name: Cauntilum
rites.text: A dark practice lets several drinkers share the power taken from one slain victim. How many may join depends on the victim's rank and strength. A later, more refined version replaced it.

rites.name: Valares Amillum
rites.text: A theoretical rite that could restore an undead creature to mortal life, though no one has ever completed it. Its outcome is uncertain, since the restored being might either shed its hungers or be absorbed into them.

rites.name: Corenium Seresum
rites.text: A practice in which a vial of stolen life-fluid is spread, drawn, or swallowed alongside other fixed substances. Performed exactly as prescribed, it always produces a set result without any need for belief or prayer.

rites.name: Oriares Testia
rites.text: A ritual in which a guide's inner dark self is pulled loose and bound into a separate sharing twin. The two stay linked, so harm to one reaches the other.

rites.name: Veollor Taurum
rites.text: A bound inner gift that lets a hunter push back against things that defy nature. Those trained in the old orders draw upon it to resist the warped and the impossible.

rites.name: Cernanum Vaurnum
rites.text: A discipline of the undead that draws strength from remembering mortal life. Practitioners hold to freedom, reason, and the inner heart, using their humanity to resist the savage hunger within.

rites.name: Orintus
rites.text: A narrow inner discipline pursued by a small secretive brotherhood of blood-drinkers who seek a deeper spiritual awakening. Its followers take on a distinct title that marks them as adepts of the path.

rites.name: Serelor Sereorinium
rites.text: A sacred art practiced by embalmed priests who cleanse and mend the living. Its mastery over frost lets practitioners shield allies or strike foes with bitter chill.

rites.name: Serinium Seronium
rites.text: A path of the night-blooded that honors a shadowed mother of the old tales. Its followers are feared as witches, guided by inner resolve and raw instinct.

rites.name: Tinanum Mornentia
rites.text: A set of shielding and restorative gifts that wardens of perilous bands trade as prized currency. Its practitioners are devoted to mercy, yet many other bearers of hidden power also covet it.

rites.name: Vantistium
rites.text: A newer, very formal path that was shaped from an older ruling discipline and absorbed the codes of warrior-oaths. It stresses duty toward those beneath its followers.

rites.name: Seornanum Corasintum
rites.text: A cold-blooded inheritance that steadies the mind against coaxing and hardens the body against toxins and venom. Those who carry it resist swayed feelings and the sting of poison alike.

rites.name: Maunia Nanum
rites.text: A set of hidden crafts lets a wielder bend the surfaces that return an image to the eye. Its practice is tied to a pull toward admiration of one's own appearance.

rites.name: Taulernor
rites.text: A blood-working craft used by a secretive brotherhood of vampires, whose practitioners are known to rival vampire clans by a name given to their methods. It is a discipline of the blood practised among their own kind.

rites.name: Raullostor
rites.text: A heightened perceptual gift that lets trained seekers feel the presence of things that defy natural order. It is an edge drawn upon by those who hunt such wrongness.

rites.name: Amauntirnum
rites.text: A fighting technique built to topple the mightiest foes. The practitioner swells into a larger, heavier form while striking with fists, feet or claws.

rites.name: Visia Vosium
rites.text: A set of household observances practiced by a people who guard their dwelling and kin. They are reserved for one lineage of kin folk.

rites.name: Roreostum
rites.text: A coordinated working where a leader, aides, and many helpers join hands around a marked ring to pool their shared power. Its effects are fearsome, though attempting it alone is dangerous and draining.

rites.name: Tarianium
rites.text: A discipline of reading signs and symbols, held as the guiding path of a learned fellowship. Its practitioners believe that understanding marks grants a form of influence over the world.

rites.name: Vaures Sarilles
rites.text: A discipline of heightened inner senses that lets a practitioner perceive glowing emanations around living things and glimpse distant places and people. It is practiced by those who have trained in certain metal-based refinement arts.

rites.name: Taurium Mianaulum
rites.text: A once-a-day allure that a spirit-folk member can call upon by spending a bit of inner charm, making them seem striking for an hour. It also sways others of a different gender, granting extra sway in conversation.

rites.name: Maulia Valiasor
rites.text: A set of hidden abilities used by shadowy wanderers who are said to bend the end of life. Its reach is only a faint echo of what far older beings can command.

rites.name: Valiasteles
rites.text: A set of hidden arts that any shapeshifting wanderer may learn to master. Those who take it up become expert at moving unseen and unheard.

rites.name: Orentauses
rites.text: Feats performed by undying adepts who have cleansed themselves, drawing on a close bond with a hidden twilight realm. They are grouped into seven schools that channel an inner vital force.

rites.name: Neontor Tentia
rites.text: A fighter with fangs clamps onto a chosen limb of an opponent and rips at its sinews. The wound leaves that limb weakened and can be repeated until it becomes useless.

rites.name: Mauliarum
rites.text: A piercing cry that a gifted bearer can call forth at a middling level of mastery. One named wanderer of the wilds also learns to wield it.

rites.name: Siasium Valinaustus
rites.text: A class of ritual practices kept by one scavenging brotherhood of shapeshifters. The practices were recorded in a later sourcebook and belong only to that brotherhood.

rites.name: Talia Valiastes
rites.text: A hidden craft of reshaping the body into a scaled, serpentine form. It also carries a tainting influence that mirrors the nature of the coiled hunter.

rites.name: Serauselum
rites.text: A blind terror seizes a bloodsucker who fails a steadiness check when facing flame or daylight, the few harms able to end its unnatural life. Certain uncanny gifts can also trigger this panic.

rites.name: Lausor Riarnes
rites.text: A keen nose grants a wanderer extra chances to notice things, allowing scent to make up for dulled senses. Many in a certain clan carry bodily shortcomings they overcome by smelling the world.

rites.name: Reornia
rites.text: A discipline in which the initiates learn to channel inner vital energy through their own bodies. Practitioners shape the flow of that energy until the body itself becomes a vessel for it.

rites.name: Seristia Leoria
rites.text: A spirit comes back from the underworld and reclaims a lifeless body without any outside hand guiding it. The one who returns becomes a different kind of being altogether.

rites.name: Mauleoses
rites.text: A discipline of self-command practiced by an ascetic order of nocturnal blood-drinkers who fast and live in want. It lets them master both their hungering inner beast and the wills of other blood-drinkers.

rites.name: Cosires
rites.text: A discipline held only by one hidden blood-line, letting its keepers speak with and call beast-like spirits. At higher mastery, these spirits lend their strength to the user.

rites.name: Cauranum
rites.text: A discipline that lets its wielders shape the forces of tempest and gale. Practitioners of this hidden art draw on the wild energies of thunder and rain.

rites.name: Salorum
rites.text: A discipline wielded by a clan of seers who can shift the dread that gathers inside a bloodsworn body, though they cannot raise or lower it, only move it from place to place.

rites.name: Serireles
rites.text: A set of enchanted bindings taken up by the fey-touched who serve a court of falling leaves. It sharpens their talent for wizardry and is most often wielded by wandering folk of that court.

rites.name: Amares
rites.text: A coded craft of inner power that a hunting brotherhood draws upon to confront the unnatural creatures that prowl the night.

rites.name: Launium Vaustum
rites.text: Specialized maneuvers that hunters devise to harm, impede, and study otherworldly beasts. Groups can teach these techniques to newcomers, and affiliated bands freely exchange them.

rites.name: Milasum
rites.text: A strange blood-working craft used to curse another being, briefly weakening one of their inner capacities. Its teachers are a secretive circle of scholars, though a lucky tinkerer might stumble onto it unaided.

rites.name: Rialanum Siantistum
rites.text: A practice of counter-working that unravels the effects of blood-based sorcery. It lets a practitioner cancel the workings of others that draw upon the life within the body.

rites.name: Cauntises
rites.text: A small whirling tempest of spirit that can warp a restless ghost's form or thoughts. It spins through the air and leaves the ghost changed.

rites.name: Collor Oreonor
rites.text: A set of uncanny powers taken up by rare beings who embrace sorrow and loss, letting their empathy and hope slowly wither. Members of a winter-aligned order most often wield these powers.

rites.name: Orirnia Rariantum
rites.text: A bond shared among a fae wanderer and their companions lets the wanderer lead a joint effort with a bonus, or set aside their own effort to sharpen a leader's throw so successes come more easily.

rites.name: Nenor Seollinanum
rites.text: A stonebound blessing that grants a bearer shoulders strong enough to carry the earth itself. Spending spirit-essence lends extra force to tasks of raw lifting and pulling, one added measure of strength for each point spent.

rites.name: Nolleorus
rites.text: A lost art of hunting the undying lord of the night, passed down through a warrior line that is often seen as merely its carrier. A secretive order of dragon-watchers recognizes its ties to a particular family of blood.

rites.name: Teleontanum Visoria
rites.text: A dark craft practiced by one hidden lineage of undead, letting its users bend the signs of rot and passing away. It resembles the raising of the dead, though it works differently.

rites.name: Telontes Naullus
rites.text: A shadowy gift granted by a cunning spirit lets its bearer, once each day at the cost of a spark of hidden power, force a rival to retake a success at a handicap, hoping the second attempt collapses. The bearer also finds oaths of their household easier to invoke.

rites.name: Raurnollium
rites.text: A single, unrepeated sorcerous rite devised by a shapeshifting blood-sorcerer of a northern river city. Its practitioner alone knows the working.

rites.name: Mentus Coriasus
rites.text: A ritual in which a guardian spirit briefly possesses a ritemaster, letting him answer three questions and reveal lies spoken in his presence. The ritemaster's eyes turn milky white and his voice takes on a crackling whisper.

rites.name: Rostor
rites.text: A demanding art where a practitioner shapes raw inner power through pure force of mind rather than trained skill. Practitioners climb three graded rings of mastery, and deepening in one grim branch of the art closes the door to another.

rites.name: Oriarnanum Reolianus
rites.text: A fighter takes a blow, shifts into a larger battle shape, and answers with a counterstrike. The hit lands easier to endure, but the maneuver costs one point of fury.

rites.name: Nisauror
rites.text: A mind-reaching art used only by one hidden bloodline of undead. Its practitioners project thought and whisper into the minds of others.

rites.name: Mausalum
rites.text: A practice of hiding one's true face and purpose behind false guises. It is also a guarded tradition among a secretive lineage that keeps its ways concealed.

rites.name: Coreosor Amalanum
rites.text: A devotee spends an hour in quiet reverence before sleep, gaining a daily store of inner strength. That store can be spent to steady the mind, shield against control, or pass resolve to a companion.

rites.name: Valaulium Teliantia
rites.text: A forbidden blood art that marks a mortal's body with sacred-looking wounds, dividing onlookers between reverence and horror. Its powers let whoever drinks the spilled lifeblood briefly sharpen their own strength and senses.

rites.name: Vorium Valasanum
rites.text: A bearer's bare hands can tear through a barrier's resistance, ignoring up to three points of its strength. The hands then function as a tool built specifically to overcome that resistance.

rites.name: Teollirnia
rites.text: A bearer shifts into a fierce war-form just as they hurl a foe, lending the throw extra footing and force. The victim flies a distance based on the margin of success plus the bearer's brawn, and harm varies with what they strike.

rites.name: Teolises
rites.text: A fighter dashes low into a foe in a wolf-like shape, knocking the opponent off balance. They then shift into a fiercer form to exploit the opening, and the struck target is thrown to the ground.

rites.name: Sausialum
rites.text: A fighter drives into a foe with a charging hold, and once the foe topples, the fighter shifts into a bulkier shape that lowers the difficulty of their next strikes. It works best when a group fights together.

rites.name: Monisia
rites.text: A creature of hungry shadow can spend a spark of its inner power to lick the bare skin of a foe. The victim is afflicted with a fraying of the mind for a week, and the creature may strike this way only once each week.

rites.name: Neollium Siastor
rites.text: A chosen storyteller may pour two extra measures of enchanted spirit into a weaving of tales, so that a successful working escapes its bitter reversal. A catastrophic failure still brings the reversal.

rites.name: Lantia Tiles
rites.text: A sworn-brotherhood gift lets a seeker tap the gathered learning of their oath-circle. Once per tale, the seeker uncovers hidden truths about a present foe, and each rank of the gift opens another informant to question.

rites.name: Siarentium
rites.text: A quick rite lets a practitioner check whether a crescent-shaped brand on a person was truly placed by a sanctioned order. Stronger readings reveal how the mark was obtained.

rites.name: Viaseror
rites.text: A hidden essential name that anchors a being's ideal self, so harm to it harms the being too. Those who learn to wield it can reach anything bearing one, which is why such names are guarded closely.

rites.name: Valeornus Visus
rites.text: A set of enchanted glamours used by the most beautiful of a fey people to make their appearance unearthly and striking. Mortals who see them glimpse the true form without retaining the memory, and those already graced by natural appeal gain slight extra advantage.

rites.name: Tantum Tialanum
rites.text: A devotion-born power that lets sincere believers make their sacred tokens bite against unnatural beings. Any creed can grant it, and loyal hearts can resist corruption through it.

rites.name: Vallum
rites.text: The final unmaking of a returned dead being, after which nothing of it can rise again. It ends every chance of a second awakening for those who have crossed into the afterlife.

rites.name: Teleneoses
rites.text: A learned ward that lets a hunter blunt the pull of things that defy nature. It is gained as a gift, a boon granted to those who track such creatures.

rites.name: Orontor Telanum
rites.text: A learned ritual discipline that bonds a vampire's soul to a powerful spirit, granting the bonded a title and a set of rites. The spirit chosen determines which rituals the practitioner may learn.

rites.name: Teleonanum
rites.text: A learned art that lets a practitioner trade vital essences between beings, mending wounds or shifting strength, but only through touch. Those who misuse it are distrusted, and failures often drain the very force the user meant to give.

rites.name: Lontia Viaralles
rites.text: A craft held only by one stone-kin lineage, letting its practitioners draw on the natural bond between their kind and rock, soil, and crafted masonry.

rites.name: Valeralum
rites.text: A quiet gift that lets a bearer read people more keenly and slip words into a listener's ear from afar. The speaker's murmur reaches the target as if spoken right beside them.

rites.name: Seolum Telasus
rites.text: A discipline that lets a practitioner sense and shape a raw inner heat, reshaping it into resolve. It is practiced by those who trained under certain refining schools.

rites.name: Miastes Amastanum
rites.text: A hidden art of wearing down a foe's strength rather than building one's own. Its practitioners sap their victims' stamina and, when they spend their lifeblood, can cripple movement and steal the first strike.

rites.name: Tallium Canus
rites.text: A set of inner arts that let a shapeshifting warrior soften his own frailties while turning the frailties of foes to his advantage. Some storm-kin scorn these arts as a dishonorable shortcut, and they are passed down by poisonous beast-spirits and certain shadowy spirit-kin.

rites.name: Nollanum Amiastornia
rites.text: A fighter strikes with a limb, then swells into a longer shape at the final instant, catching the foe off guard with extra reach. Only certain human-like warriors can perform the maneuver.

rites.name: Vistenus
rites.text: A set of guardian gifts given to wandering outcasts so they can shield a chosen place. Mentors from spirit realms teach these gifts, and several secretive brotherhoods have made them their own discipline.

rites.name: Cesauntum
rites.text: A bond that lets a dark-natured tempter sway anyone sharing the same weakness, granting bonus favor in dealings with them. When the shared weakness is desire, the favor doubles, and the tempter's own allure grows sharper.

rites.name: Reostanum Vausialium
rites.text: A set of strange marks that only certain chosen seekers can read and write. Its power to be made and understood was granted to these seekers by heavenly couriers.

rites.name: Tereolus
rites.text: A defender uses an attacker's own rush against them, grabbing their wrists to hurl several assailants aside in one turn. Each opponent contests the throw by rolling their skill against the number of foes, and the one who rolls better either sends the other sprawling or takes ground for themselves.

rites.name: Sausia
rites.text: A set of harmful inner gifts taught to outcasts, effective only against shapeshifters of the wolf-kind. Some elders scorn them, since their sole purpose is to fight rival changelings, and restless, wrathful spirits often pass them on.

rites.name: Orilanum Miarnanum
rites.text: A discipline of hidden arts in which practitioners draw on unseen forces through a charged vocabulary of ritual. Its adherents are often mocked for their affected manners and grand claims.

rites.name: Reontiasium
rites.text: A blood-based craft used only by one closed circle of sorcerers, made of many odd powers that look like other arts. The circle lets others assume it commands them all and never corrects them.

rites.name: Saures
rites.text: A reverse surge of unstable energy that strikes spellcasters during a flourishing era of learning. It rebounds against the one who channels power and leaves them shaken.

rites.name: Vorugok
rites.text: Vorugok is a concept of the Tasianium cosmos, the stillness that held before the Fall and the Sundering. It stands as the first oath of the Pact, the vow that bound the Shards of broken worlds into a single song.

rites.name: Tareonia
rites.text: Tareonia is the concept of the Fall in Tasianium, the moment worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn among the surviving shards. It is remembered as the force that holds fractured realms in an uneasy bond during the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Solliantor
rites.text: A practitioner who crosses into the dream-realms forms a duplicate of their own body there. This double treats the otherworldly surroundings as solid, obeying the same laws, though the practitioner may bend them with craft; it lasts only while the practitioner's inner resolve holds.

rites.name: Lentum
rites.text: A potent craft that grants its wielder keen senses, starting with sharpened everyday perception and growing into deeper insight. It reveals hidden truths and pierces deceptions, so few secrets can stay concealed from a true master.

rites.name: Corarniales
rites.text: A craft of drawing poisonous vapors from the air to sicken foes. It works best against the living and others of their kind, since the unliving resist such fumes.

rites.name: Corirnium Corintor
rites.text: An unseen halo that every awakened maker exudes, growing stronger as their inner essence swells. It stirs dormant hunters, lets kin sense one another's sensitive signatures, and can be dimmed on purpose to avoid detection.

rites.name: Orilus
rites.text: A ghost-binding craft that lets a practitioner tug on threads of the dead's netted realm to sway both spirits and living people. It is a power taken up by those who walk between the worlds.

rites.name: Orialus
rites.text: An ageless wanderer who slips its consciousness into another living person's body by sheer will or forbidden rites. The arrangement holds only under certain exceptions.

rites.name: Nollarnum
rites.text: A practice lets a being train its hidden inner self like a wayward kin, sometimes wearing that inner face openly. Its users can drive outsiders into wild frenzy, but the practice often turns back on its wielders.

rites.name: Nollor Cesanum
rites.text: A deliberate scheme that pushes ordinary folk into dire circumstances so that their latent gifts are forced awake. Its practitioners aim to multiply the number of gifted people in the land.

rites.name: Nollia
rites.text: A dark craft that lets its wielders sense and tug at the strands of destiny through whispers, visions, and dream-memories. It reaches farther than simpler foresight and feeds on the wielder's inner vitality, though it is practiced quietly by lesser ranks and is nearly universal among the factions.

rites.name: Ciaronia
rites.text: A practitioner's outline dissolves into a rippling haze that lets them move through a crowd unseen. The veil breaks the moment someone catches sight of them, and it returns only after the watcher is turned aside.

rites.name: Vestornanum
rites.text: A discipline that treats the body, mind, and spirit as intricate machines that can be studied and adjusted. Practitioners first refine themselves, then gradually attempt to tune the workings of others and of whole communities.

rites.name: Lilanum Telontiania
rites.text: This hidden power governs the end of living things, letting its wielder command restless echoes, steal the essence of a spirit, and drain away the years of a foe. Its practitioners are feared for the dominion they gain over souls themselves.

rites.name: Valeostor
rites.text: A universal set of sleep-weaving talents that any being may learn. Those who master it shape and steer the minds of sleepers, and are said to bend the wild borderlands more easily.

rites.name: Valaulium
rites.text: A discipline for shaping and releasing a crackling current drawn from the body. Its practitioners range from those who power simple devices to those who strike with searing bolts, and it is studied by followers of an old refining craft.

rites.name: Vausor
rites.text: A practitioner draws frost out of the air and things around them. They can shield themselves from cold, snuff flames with a look, freeze liquids and flesh solid, and make objects cling together.

rites.name: Nerolus
rites.text: A specialized craft drawn from grief and the pull of the void. It lets its user work the dark currents that bind the living to the hollow beyond.

rites.name: Nantiallia
rites.text: A hidden true body that a creature reveals beneath its disguise, a warped echo of its former shape that grows more its own over time. Revealing it heals every wound and restores strength, but leaves the one who did so marked for ruin afterward.

rites.name: Veostes
rites.text: A dream-based healing craft practiced by a secret brotherhood of watchers. Practitioners sleep in prepared chambers and enter altered trance states through meditation, using these visions to heal or to harm.

rites.name: Neles
rites.text: A set of bright, scorching powers that a fae-touched wanderer can draw upon, channeling the harsh blaze of midday sun through heat and light. Its wielders often belong to a warm-hued fellowship.

rites.name: Vontor
rites.text: A innate talent carried by chosen figures, reflecting their temperament and past along with an ancestral lineage. It grants automatic advantages on everyday efforts when paired with a related trained skill, and unlocks special gifts that scale with the bearer's investment.

rites.name: Teles Siarnaunor
rites.text: A creature regains its hunger-quenched strength by quietly watching another creature of the night successfully stalk and take its prey. Witnessing the kill in person draws the watcher closer to the hunter, and if the hunter also drinks from the victim, the watcher gains even more.

rites.name: Serellium
rites.text: A savage inner force born from fierce passions like vengeance and rage, it drives hunger, madness, and bodily change. It serves as the currency of beings caught between living and dying, and its bearers are aggressive and restless.

rites.name: Sallia Corines
rites.text: A shroud that makes the living instinctively refuse to believe in their own presence. The restless dead give it this name.

rites.name: Corelum
rites.text: A script of looping marks that is said to show the flow of reality itself, rather than sounds or everyday objects. Its marks can be inscribed on a working to make the effect last longer, and are often used in rites and protective barriers.

rites.name: Amirneolum
rites.text: A small flash of understanding that a guiding presence bestows upon a traveler during a moment of danger. It offers one clue that helps them through that particular trouble.

rites.name: Salus
rites.text: A set of bonds that let a wielder take on the traits of a chosen creature type. Each bond is learned separately and tied to one kind of beast, and a shared affinity makes new bonds cheaper to learn.

rites.name: Naustium Meostiror
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a fighter who has been seized soak more punishment from the hold and more easily wrench free of a lasting grip. Schools that teach seizing moves usually teach this counter as well.

rites.name: Vesauntium
rites.text: A gift that lets a practitioner glimpse another being's bygone days or coming years, and read the final destiny of a restless spirit. Seers often lean on cards, charts, or other ritual props to sharpen their visions.

rites.name: Tausallor
rites.text: A bloodline-bound craft that lets the members of one particular lineage of the undead rise into the air and glide across the sky. No other kin can channel it.

rites.name: Seroreolles
rites.text: A fighter leaps feet-first into the air toward a foe and finishes with a forceful kick aimed at the head or torso. It counts as an aerial maneuver.

rites.name: Amesteosum
rites.text: A spirit's blessing lets a mischievous being touch a machine and spend a spark of charm to strip away its borrowed strength for the rest of a scene. Each being may invoke this only once per day.

rites.name: Mialontanum
rites.text: A middle battle shape that a fighter takes on, granting great martial strength while stirring a faint, dizzying frenzy in those nearby. Certain tribal kin know this shape by a different name.

rites.name: Vornus Venes
rites.text: A specialized craft in which a practitioner speaks with their own inner shadows and base urges. It requires a mind-focused discipline and is traced back to an ancient wise ruler.

rites.name: Seraunesium
rites.text: A serene inner state in which an undead drinker of blood rises above its hunger and its mortal longings, living in harmony with both halves of its nature. Some eastern kin call this peace by another name.

rites.name: Sisor Virum
rites.text: A added enhancement that alters a standard energy power with extra effects. It can be bought permanently with accumulated points, or borrowed temporarily by pushing a power to its limit, which risks corruption.

rites.name: Mestinia
rites.text: A gift that lets a maker's hands work with uncanny skill, sometimes with clockwork threaded into their own flesh. Its bearer rolls with extra reliability when building, mending, or altering devices, and can spend a spark of inner power to add more dice to such efforts.

rites.name: Telonus Cillium
rites.text: A bard lulls listeners into a dreamy trance using music or song, spending a spark of inner power. Those who fall under it become easier to sway and think less sharply for the rest of the moment.

rites.name: Orianus Tentium
rites.text: A quiet craft that bends the longings of other restless spirits with only a glance. Practitioners are feared, since a failed attempt can plant the very opposite of what was intended.

rites.name: Valeontelor
rites.text: A ruling art of imposing strict routines on others, binding captives and subjects alike. Its practitioners limit their own liberty as tightly as they limit the freedom of those they hold.

rites.name: Veornanum
rites.text: A craft of transforming matter through radiant energy, usually practiced by a single bloodline. Outsiders who attempt it risk losing their grip on their humanity with each use.

rites.name: Seorintium
rites.text: A blended craft that joins a seer's sense of perception with an illusion-weaving skill, letting the practitioner stir longing in others.

rites.name: Serantanum
rites.text: A craft that lets a being sense and bend the flow of time, sharpening its own precision while dulling another's. It can also strip the usefulness from a target's belongings, leaving them functionless.

rites.name: Valeornes Oristiantus
rites.text: A hidden wellspring that awakens within certain folk, granting them extraordinary gifts. It may flare up suddenly like a burst of heat or slowly build through relentless effort, and the gifts shaped by it follow the path each person chooses.

rites.name: Laustium
rites.text: A bearer gains an uncanny memory and a knack for finding hidden records. Those who carry it can spend a spark of inner power to recall a single answer with perfect clarity.

rites.name: Serauntum Ceolisor
rites.text: A set of learned bodily techniques that let a trained fighter grip with lethal force, strike with ruinous power, leap farther, and hurl objects over greater distances. Each technique builds on the one before it.

rites.name: Nanollium
rites.text: A set of gifts given to outcasts by restless spirits of machines and vermin, focused on gathering useful facts. Those who hold these gifts feel a kinship with the forge-lords of iron.

rites.name: Celiantanum
rites.text: A dark hum of death's own energy that clings to scholars who study the underworld too deeply. It works like a corrupting drift that wears away those who handle its craft carelessly.

rites.name: Silia
rites.text: A craft that lets its users strengthen, weaken, or watch over the bonds that hold a spirit to its anchors. Practitioners can inspect others' bonds, but cannot strike at a rival directly.

rites.name: Rallus Valantum
rites.text: A faculty that lets a seer perceive the shifting colored halos surrounding living or animate beings. It stands as the reverse of a gift that reveals the dead.

rites.name: Telistium Serollus
rites.text: A clawed fighter vaults over a rival and rakes them while airborne. The strike only works when the leap carries the fighter clear past the opponent.

rites.name: Lisum
rites.text: A dark craft that siphons life-force and dread from the living and the dead to sustain a hungry host. Its practitioners are warlike raiders who use it to heal their own forces and to break the strongholds of their foes.

rites.name: Laurnia
rites.text: A ninth power of making that gives living growth its shape. A council of nine circles keeps one seat for its keepers, and its hidden realm lies bound to a distant morning star.

rites.name: Vaullernia
rites.text: A craft that lets the bound shatter the fabric of existence so that outer gloom seeps through, briefly warping natural law, sense, and mind. Its uses carry heavy inner cost for the wielder.

rites.name: Seorialles
rites.text: A discipline of thought and distance that governs the mind and the spaces between things, with matter lying weakly within its reach. Its practitioners gain strength by confronting hardship and breaking through opposition.

rites.name: Oraustosum
rites.text: A channeling art that lets a select order of messengers carry a higher sovereign's will to allied houses, guiding and reinforcing their workings. It can even seize control of those workings when needed.

rites.name: Valaustia Orirnolanum
rites.text: A bearer of moon-given favor may once each day pass a fevered madness to a touched person, both sharing the affliction. Success spares the bearer entirely, while the victim bears it longer.

rites.name: Neornium Celiantor
rites.text: A craft of reshaping flesh, letting a practitioner grow claws or fangs, stretch their limbs, or form a small artificial being. Those who trained in a certain refining discipline use it.

rites.name: Nistor
rites.text: A mastery over lifeless matter that lets its wielder shape any object from any material, from crowns of glass to blades of stone. It can also imbue crafted things with wondrous enchantments or burdensome curses.

rites.name: Valernanum
rites.text: A practice of bending the rules of a higher realm into the ordinary world, letting practitioners reach hidden places, move minds between bodies, and conjure light in darkness. Its workings are all wondrous to behold.

rites.name: Valia Lelornum
rites.text: A mental gift that only the blood of one ancient lineage can awaken. Those who carry it perceive moments in a fractured, disordered way.

rites.name: Rastor
rites.text: A craft that lets practitioners bend the everyday pulls of weight, drag, and push so they move swifter and strike harder. Any practitioner may learn it, regardless of their lineage.

rites.name: Molleones
rites.text: A fighting form of a wandering spirit, a middle state between its gentle shape and its full war shape. It resembles the battle-form of a feral warrior clan.

rites.name: Cirnanum Seoranum
rites.text: A corrupted inverse of the sacred tongue of spellcraft, it is a tangled script of jagged marks that most minds cannot follow. Those fluent in it can strengthen their workings, but doing so invites backlash from the fabric of reality.

rites.name: Tollerium
rites.text: A craft for reshaping the unliving substances of the world, from repairing broken objects to turning one material into another. Its practitioners grow subtler in their skill as they master harder and more complex materials.

rites.name: Viallus Teosus
rites.text: A craft that lets its practitioners bend radiance, forging dazzling shafts of brightness or weaving intricate false images. It shares much of its shape with a related art of phantom making.

rites.name: Orestum Telosaurnia
rites.text: This craft guides the lingering essence of living beings toward a place beyond, and once mortality arrived it also shepherded minds into hidden refuges. It leads rather than commands, which keeps it quietly effective.

rites.name: Corausor Seorus
rites.text: A bearer extends an unseen thread of inner essence toward a thing or a living being, binding it and forcing it to obey their will. Those who can perceive such threads see the bearer's hand reaching out to seize their target.

rites.name: Orentaunor
rites.text: A rare inner art practiced by one ancient bloodline of healers. It mends the wounds and afflictions of others, and it was once known by a different name.

rites.name: Amiallum
rites.text: A mental craft that reshapes how a person perceives the world around them. Practitioners of a guild-like order use it to alter what a mind takes to be real.

rites.name: Cistellia
rites.text: A gift granted to a chosen people that lets them sense the exact passing hour and count moments with flawless precision. It sharpens timing and grants knowledge of the heavens and their signs.

rites.name: Telauntus
rites.text: Telauntus are glowing sigils that take shape within a dreamer's sleeping mind, each one standing for a single remembered moment.

rites.name: Voleontes
rites.text: A discipline that studies the inner powers of the thinking self, allowing trained minds to act beyond ordinary bodily means. Governing bodies in this world oversee its practice under a title centered on the reasoning mind.

rites.name: Corostaules
rites.text: A forbidden craft lets its user trace and read the memories of others. Practitioners can sense lies, gaining advantage in bargains, though many drift toward hoarding secrets for blackmail.

rites.name: Maustanum Rianausanum
rites.text: A hidden shape that certain Veiled scholars can take when they study the threads of recurring design. It belongs to one lineage of learned wanderers who have mastered reading those hidden designs.

rites.name: Orollenia
rites.text: A craft of dark blood-working that reaches only toward the realm of the departed and their restless shadow-lands. Several schools practise it, and it grew from older grave-arts merged with a secret family's art of the night.

rites.name: Corinum Seonterium
rites.text: A swift evasive technique in which the user shrinks her body mid-dodge, letting the effort she spent on transformation sharpen her later evasions this turn. Spending a burst of inner fury can stand in for the transformation itself.

rites.name: Vernus Rontelles
rites.text: A craft that stirs the euphoric haze of narcotic highs within a listener's mind. Its practitioners use it to lure others into hungry dependence on a tainted essence they can drink.

rites.name: Leosanum Valiasum
rites.text: A bloodborne discipline that grants a creature unnatural bodily vigor and strength beyond the reach of ordinary flesh. Those who wield it move and lift with a power no mortal could match.

rites.name: Riasia
rites.text: A chaotic craft that lets its practitioners stir havoc among the living through grim and theatrical illusions. Its wielders often spark the eerie tales that gather around haunted places, though those who wield it are hunted by the ruling powers.

rites.name: Teliasum Mistaunus
rites.text: A dark counterpart to one of the nine basic arts of shaping reality, pulsing with a corrupting resonance. Its power is mostly wielded by sinister cultists, though some wandering practitioners have also been pulled toward it.

rites.name: Serires
rites.text: These are vast ritual workings that let practitioners sway many targets simultaneously or unleash a ruinous effect. Each one is a long, elaborate procedure drawn from the dark arts.

rites.name: Telirausium
rites.text: A dampening sleep that lulls the inner spark of living folk, dulling their awareness so they accept a false picture of the world. It also resists any glimpse of hidden power, making minds recoil from it.

rites.name: Valantus
rites.text: A mind-clouding affliction that bends a caster's perception of the world after they lean too heavily on one current of inner power. Some sufferers never shake it, living permanently warped by its grip.

rites.name: Amistor
rites.text: A learned art of unnatural charm that lets its practitioners draw in onlookers, stir their feelings, and bend whole gatherings to their will.

rites.name: Reosaunanum
rites.text: A practice in which a traveler passes into a hidden realm that lies beside the ordinary world. Those who use it call the crossing by a shared everyday term.

rites.name: Telirneosia
rites.text: A discipline held by one hidden bloodline that works through scent. Its practitioners craft perfumes, oils, and soaps that carry supernatural influence over those who breathe them.

rites.name: Oreostus
rites.text: A wordless tongue that the spirits of the loom use to pass knowledge among themselves and align their work. It is spoken through patterns rather than sounds, letting many servants act as one.

rites.name: Raurnilia
rites.text: A bodily technique in which a person instinctively burns an inner life-essence to briefly boost their strength or swiftness. The surge fades once the reserve is spent.

rites.name: Oriastirnes
rites.text: A shared gift open to any shifting folk who choose it, letting them glimpse slices of what has passed and what may come. Such beings stand outside ordinary time, and their sight reaches only a narrow distance.

rites.name: Casanum Tenaria
rites.text: A long inner journey that every made being walks toward the condition of mortal life. Each step taken along it is personal, and the moments that mark progress reshape a hidden inner essence.

rites.name: Nernales
rites.text: A mental discipline that lets a practitioner vent heat from their own body, hurl scorching air, kindle flammable materials, melt solids, and shape flame into chosen forms. Adepts may also heal through fever, sense warmth in darkness, or convert light into heat.

rites.name: Corauntor Soselia
rites.text: A venomous discipline taught to members of one disciplined lineage, drawing on the body's inner energy to sharpen nimbleness. Its clean counterpart flows from the same source.

rites.name: Oroniria
rites.text: A gift that lets a shapeshifting wanderer lay a hand on someone else and drain a sliver of their vitality to mend its own wounds. The drain is limited by a cost and by the wanderer's inner strength.

rites.name: Reolonia
rites.text: A bond of inherited gifts lets certain shapeshifters reshape solid, inert matter by touch while in their half-beast forms. Charged or living things and metals resistant to such change cannot be altered this way.

rites.name: Siantor Veonaures
rites.text: A distilled spell recipe refined by many casters, written as a checklist of gestures and rhythms. Its symbols filter raw power through familiar everyday meaning, so casting it strains the caster less and is easier to perform.

rites.name: Amaurarnum
rites.text: A fighter deliberately transforms mid-clash into a savage beast-form to take a blow they foresee, shielding vital areas. This sets up a swift counterstrike while the attacker finds it harder to land a hit.

rites.name: Tistum Vollernes
